bbc3.uk.title: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder
bbc3.uk.description: After a three-minute video featuring a female prison officer and an inmate having sex inside HMP Wandsworth goes viral, award-winning journalist Mobeen Azhar begins an investigation into what happened and why. A year of twists, turns and damning revelations pulls back the curtain on a dangerous wider world of coercion, corruption and contraband thriving behind bars.

bbc3.uk.title: Behind Bars: Sex, Bribes and Murder
bbc3.uk.description: As Mobeen's investigation deepens, it becomes clearer that illicit relationships between prisoners and jail staff are just the tip of the iceberg. The bigger story involves organised criminal gangs determined to cash in on a lucrative prison drug economy. When news breaks of a prison governor being jailed for a relationship with a drug-dealing gang boss, Mobeen becomes determined to uncover the true extent of criminal influence inside our prisons.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Scam Interceptors
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S6 E12 Foal Play The ground team are dispatched to stop a woman from Woking paying out to a known cryptocurrency scam, but everything seems to be going against them, including the local roadworks. The team also join forces with an ethical hacker to investigate a man from Cameroon claiming to sell horses on social media.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Doorbell Detectives
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S2 E4 Matt Allwright hears how Linda rushed over to her 87-year-old father's house after a group of rogue traders turned up saying he needed work doing. Plus, a man who chased down a gang of suspected car thieves.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: Escape to the Country
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S26 E38 Devon Nicki Chapman helps a retired couple from Northamptonshire find their perfect coastal retreat in Devon. They're dreaming of a single-storey home close to the sea, and one of the properties delivers breathtaking ocean views right from the terrace. Nicki also meets a couple raising a family in a Dartmoor village, who share their love of the outdoors by mapping walks in the National Park for all ages and abilities to enjoy.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Repair Shop on the Road
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S1 Highlands - Treasure in the Attic Dominic Chinea is joined by an Inverness plastering expert to try to preserve art painted by Polish soldiers on the walls of the attic of Nairn Museum during the Second World War. Will Kirk is in Beauly to meet Alan MacPherson, who instructs him in the intricacies of creating shinty sticks to stand up to the rigours of this hard-fought game.

bbconemidlands.uk.title: The Finish Line
bbconemidlands.uk.description: S4 E19 Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Lee, Has, Nina, Rob and Amanda race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. The contenders battle across a series of fast-paced qualifiers and head-to-head races where the aim of the game is simple - to make it to the finish line before their rivals. The winner then races against the track itself in an attempt to win the cash prize Roman Kemp and Sarah Greene host the quiz in which Lee, Has, Nina, Rob and Amanda race in moving podiums across the studio floor to try to win £5,000. At the end of each round, the team with the most points is eliminated until the final two pairs battle for a cash prize. Presented by Alexander Armstrong and Vick Hope.

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Ealing Broadway to South Kensington
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo reaches the capital. In the Queen of the Suburbs, Ealing, he finds comedy at the home of British cinema and is transformed for the silver screen by expert hair and make-up. In Fulham, Michael heads underground to London's new super sewer, which is taking shape beneath the River Thames. In central London, he visits the London School of Economics and Political Science. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Piccadilly Circus to Gravesend
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo hits the West End to explore an exotic store, which was a favourite among Edwardian ladies. At Covent Garden's Royal Ballet School he hears how in 1909 a Russian ballet company took London by storm and how its prima ballerina inspired the school's founding choreographer. Leaving the capital from Charing Cross, Michael heads for Dartford in Kent, where he discovers the origins of netball and gymslips at the North Kent College. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - East Malling to Rye
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo travels from Warwick to Rye in East Sussex. In the orchards of East Malling, Kent, Michael discovers that the Edwardians' serious attitude towards cultivation bore fruit. Rootstock developed at the NIAB Centre for Fruit Research, established in 1913, is today responsible for much of world apple production. (Documentary, Travel) - 2019

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Newcastle to County Durham
eden.uk.plus1.description: Beginning just outside Newcastle in Jarrow, Michael uncovers the desperation which led 200 men to march 300 miles to Westminster in order to petition the Government for work. In Newcastle, Michael admires the city's iconic railway bridge before heading to Byker, where he discovers a new innovation in greyhound racing. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Kielder Forest to Edinburgh
eden.uk.plus1.description: Steered by his 1936 Bradshaw's Guide, Michael Portillo is in Northumbria en route to the Highlands. On this leg, he explores Kielder Forest, beginning at the County Show in Stocksfield. Michael discovers what lay behind a national initiative to plant one of the largest man-made woodlands in Europe. Crossing the border to Scotland, Michael arrives in the weaving town of Hawick to visit Lovat Mill, where, in the 1930s, tweed was big business. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

eden.uk.plus1.title: Great British Railway Journeys - Falkirk to Dundee
eden.uk.plus1.description: Michael Portillo's railway journey through 1930s Britain from Newcastle to Loch Ness reaches Falkirk in Scotland. Here he discovers the Westerglen Transmitting Station, from where they continue to broadcast analogue radio signal to the Scottish borders. Following the route of the old Caledonian Railway Company Michael discovers the `Riviera of the Highlands'. (Documentary, Travel) - 2020

highstreettv5.uk.title: New: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House
highstreettv5.uk.description: Helen Flanagan & Bobby Davro. Actress Helen Flanagan asks Angus to sell some Corrie keepsakes and haute couture, while comedian Bobby Davro brings coins and sporting memorabilia.

highstreettv5.uk.title: The Repair Shop
highstreettv5.uk.description: Deep in the countryside, expert restorers take in Britain's broken and battered artefacts and bring them back to life while learning the rich history of the objects.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: How do they run Ryker's Island, one of the biggest jails in the world? How do they make the famous Royal Mail post box? And how do they turn fruit into jam.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: How do they make playing cards that can defeat a cheat? How do they brew a billion bottles of lager a year? And how do they make the world's most luxurious private jets.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: How do they put the holes in Swiss cheese? How do they restore and improve a classic battle tank? And how do robotic librarians run one of the world's biggest book collections.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How Do They Do It?
highstreettv5.uk.description: How do they persuade an oyster to grow a perfect pearl? How do they put the twist in classic Pennsylvania pretzels? And how do they build Venice's traditional gondolas.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Rare Survivors. Serkan and Jay visit a Victorian steam museum, while Serkan and Alister Dryburgh get to trawl through storage containers at a Kent country house.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Provenance Counts. Serkan, Jay and Viki hunt for items with remarkable history. In Somerset they visit a family-run quarry, and a collection of circus artefacts.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
highstreettv5.uk.description: VW Beetle Karmann Cabriolet. Paul and Drew take on their biggest restoration yet, a VW Beetle Karmann Cabriolet. The car is in terrible condition, but Drew is determined to save it.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How It's Made
highstreettv5.uk.description: More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including levels, hot dogs, abrasive grains and sandpaper.

highstreettv5.uk.title: How It's Made
highstreettv5.uk.description: More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including ice cream treats, wooden golf clubs and aircraft wings.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Teleshopping
highstreettv5.uk.description: Teleshopping.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Teleshopping
highstreettv5.uk.description: Teleshopping.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
highstreettv5.uk.description: Automata Acrobatics. Automata artisans Michael and Maria restore an acrobatic figurine from France. Meanwhile, sculptor Nick revives a pair of fairground ride motorbikes.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Branching Out. Drew heads to a Kent antiques emporium specialising in unusual European antiques, and indulges in 1940s nostalgia at a home front museum in South West Wales.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Balbithan. Drew goes North of the border on a road trip for an epic private house clearance in a remote part of Scotland, and he visits a historic cutlery factory in Sheffield.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: The Poseidon Crew receive devastating news about their mining permits. The Dust Devils gamble big on a quartz reef. Shane and Russell strike gold.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Aussie Gold Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: A new crew are under threat from crocodiles and accusations of illegal prospecting. The Victoria Diggers receive some welcome help.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Outback Opal Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: In Deep. The Boulder Boys drain floodwater in search of opals. Rod Manning is under pressure after using his wife's favourite opal ring as collateral.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Outback Opal Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Machines. The Blacklighters must relocate Opalzilla after their claim runs dry of opal. The Cheals hope to hit the jackpot in a bizarre structure, the Z-fault.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Salvage Hunters
highstreettv5.uk.description: Drew and Tee are excited by the items on offer at the largest antiques market in Italy. And, they visit a picturesque town in Spain to look at a fascinating collection.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars
highstreettv5.uk.description: Ford Transit. Henry and Fuzz visit Warwickshire to revive a battered Ford Transit. Once a workhorse of Britain, now a rusted relic longing for a second life.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried
highstreettv5.uk.description: Graham Steeler. Henry and Fuzz head to Southend to visit Graham's shed full of bikes and muscle cars. They find a Dutton kit car and rows and rows of rare bikes.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried
highstreettv5.uk.description: Will Ralph. Henry and Fuzz visit a farm near Colchester with vintage tractors galore. The boys come away with a classic Fordson and some old traffic lights.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
highstreettv5.uk.description: Henry and Simon head to High Wycombe, Buckinghamshire to unearth some treasures in the barns. They spot a pair of ornate candle holders and a go-cart.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Celebrity Yorkshire Auction House
highstreettv5.uk.description: Dominic Littlewood & Lisa George. In Dom Littlewood's stylish seaside pad, Angus finds a rare guitar. Then, he checks out 1950s treasures at soap star Lisa George's home.

highstreettv5.uk.title: The Yorkshire Auction House
highstreettv5.uk.description: A Lost Masterpiece? Angus spies a treasure whilst helping a couple downsize and turns detective to identify whether a work of art is by a very famous artist or not.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Antiques Road Trip
highstreettv5.uk.description: Mysterious Girl. In the border towns of Scotland and England, who is the mysterious lady in the photograph, and will a parrot make the journey home.

highstreettv5.uk.title: Shed And Buried

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 2
amc.us.description: Retired super-assassin John Wick's plans to resume a quiet civilian life are cut short when Italian gangster Santino D'Antonio shows up on his doorstep with a gold marker, compelling him to repay past favors. Ordered by Winston, kingpin of secret assassin society The Continental, to respect the organization's ancient code, Wick reluctantly accepts the assignment to travel to Rome to take out D'Antonio's sister, the ruthless capo atop the Italian Camorra crime syndicate. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

amc.us.title: John Wick: Chapter 4
amc.us.description: With the price on his head ever-increasing, legendary hit man John Wick takes his fight against the High Table global as he seeks out the most powerful players in the underworld, from New York to Paris to Japan to Berlin. (Action) - 2023

amc.us.description: After gunning down a member of the High Table -- the shadowy international assassin's guild -- legendary hit man John Wick finds himself stripped of the organization's protective services. (Action, Thriller, Adventure, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2019

amc.us.title: The Replacements
amc.us.description: It's late in the season; the playoffs are fast approaching; and the Washington Sentinels have just gone on strike. Scrambling for a solution, the Sentinels' owner Edward O'Neil hatches a plan to bring in legendary coach Jimmy McGinty to recruit a team of replacement players in exactly one week. For fans and owners alike, the strike is a disaster. But for Shane Falco and a mismatched crew of outsiders, it is the second chance they've waited their whole lives for. (Comedy) - 2000

amc.us.title: Rudy
amc.us.description: Rudy Ruettiger (Sean Astin) wants to play football at the University of Notre Dame, but has neither the money for tuition nor the grades to qualify for a scholarship. Rudy redoubles his efforts to get out of the steel mill where his father works when his best friend (Christopher Reed) dies in an accident there. Overcoming his dyslexia thanks to his friend and tutor, D-Bob (Jon Favreau), Rudy gains admission to Notre Dame and begins to fight his way onto the school's fabled football team. (Drama) - 1993

An unlikely friendship develops between Walt and the teen, as he learns he has more in common with his neighbors than he thought. (Drama) - 2008

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe starts walking with her neck bent down so she can smell the flowers and see what she's missing on the ground.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Squirrel invites his friends to come play with him in his new tree house.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Rabbit has received a package. Everyone is curious to know what's inside.

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and BamBam set out to play in the garden and see a banana tree. Join them and discover how many ways there are to have fun playing imaginative games with big banana leaves!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam play I Spy when Bambam spots a frog! That's when the fun begins as they hop and jump around like frogs

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam go cherry picking. One of the cherries rolls down the hill staight into an anthill. Billy and Bambam let the ant have the cherry to share with her family.

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become country singers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles drums and a guitar! Enjoy Mona as she plays great music in a unique one-girl band! S1 Ep25

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become tailors! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a sewing machine! Step into the workshop and see that a sewing mistake turns out great!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become chefs! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a cookbook! Step into the kitchen and help prepare tasty cold fly soup and acorn salad! S1 Ep27

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail is afraid of the dark and his torch has gone out! See the glowing firefly friends he meets! Learn the special language of lights and enjoy the magical firefly song!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a stunning butterfly, cute caterpillar and cocoon! Find out how they are related! Mother lays an egg! Caterpillar hatches and weaves a cocoon! Butterfly comes out!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: There is no limit to the lengths our three brave pirates will go to in order to find the pirate treasure.

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: There is no limit to the lengths our three brave pirates will go to in order to find the pirate treasure.

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Can you whistle? Join Mr. Snail as he looks for guinea pig - the champion whistler! Learn how to whistle like a guinea pig!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets wonderful warblers in a thicket! Come along and play hide and seek with Mr. Snail and the warblers!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: On their way to finding the treasure, the Lollipops run into a friendly octopus.

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit a winter wonderland! Roller coasters and Ferris wheels on ice!

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu explore the magical world of the orient in winter. They cross bridges, sail on boats and fly on a dragon. S1 Ep9

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: Harley and Perry are going on a picnic, but choosing the perfect spot proves to be difficult.

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix is watering the beautiful flowers to bloom. But when Pix is out of the water, Leo comes to the rescue and fills more from the stream.

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli bumps into Shere Khan while wandering alone in the jungle. Shere Khan tries to intimidate him but all his tactics don't seem to work.

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: Today the postwoman arrives on the island with a gift to deliver. Each friend is certain the gift belongs to them. But who is the real recipient?

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: The friends are excited for their first band performance. But everybody plays so loud and makes too much noise. S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Little Lola and Charlie have fun with the animals on the farm. Join them in this classic rendition of Old McDonald.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Italy. Maria, the King's daughter doesn't want to eat! S1 Ep13

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the animal friends as they visit Australia. John blows into a hollow branch so that his friends can hear him after he gets stuck on a tree! S1 Ep2

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Shusha eats, talks and walks very fast! Join Shusha as she moves fast and dances Samba on the beach to the beat of the amazing drum! S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become explorers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a boat! Sail the seas and discover the best treasure. S1 Ep22

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become mail carriers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a mail bag! Turtle wants to receive mail!

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? Toothpaste to put on a toothbrush!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam find a mouse in their tree house. When he disappears, they decide to play mouse race!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam have toy robots! When their batteries run out Billy and Bambam use cardboard boxes to become robots themselves!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Little Cabin in the Woods is a popular and fun song that teaches toddlers and young children colors and shapes with yummy fruits.

babytv.uk.title: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue
babytv.uk.description: Laz gets stuck in a hole in the fence after trying to save Hop's hat. Hop and Butterson go on a wild ride in a paper airplane to try and save her.

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: Vroom vroom! Start your engines, it's show time! Olly the race car driver is up against Snail. Who will win the trophy?

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Needles, Bouncy and Florence learn how to play Land and Sea with a hula hoop. Come see what else they can do with a hula hoop.

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Elephant has a brand new hat that she loves, but the wind blew it right off her head!

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe has a sore throat and can't come out to play.

babytv.uk.title: The Tiny Bunch
babytv.uk.description: Giraffe, Squirrel, and Baby want to play with a ball. Will they be able to take the ball from Elephant's house without waking her up? S1 Ep15

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam find a box of colorful chalks but they don't have a chalkboard. What are they going to do? Play hopscotch of course!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam find a mouse in their tree house. When he disappears, they decide to play mouse race!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam have toy robots! When their batteries run out Billy and Bambam use cardboard boxes to become robots themselves!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become explorers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a boat! Sail the seas and discover the best treasure. S1 Ep22

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become mail carriers! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a mail bag! Turtle wants to receive mail!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Mona and Sketch as they set out to become pilots! Join the fun as Sketch scribbles a plane! Fly high in the sky! S1 Ep30

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail explores moles in a cauliflower field! Who's digging all the holes? Join Mr. Snail as he discovers that moles live underground!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Join Mr. Snail on his adventure to discover where bananas grow! Mr. Snail meets parrot and learns that they repeat what they hear!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: The three brave pirates are on their way to new and exciting adventures at sea!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Pirates!
babytv.uk.description: The three brave pirates are on their way to new and exciting adventures at sea!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets a friendly fly and rabbit! The carrot is stuck in the ground! Join Mr. Snail as he tries to help!

babytv.uk.title: Snail Trail
babytv.uk.description: Mr. Snail meets another snail that's missing his shell! Snails need shells to protect them from drying up!

babytv.uk.title: Ahoy Lollipops
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops have to solve a riddle in order to cross the waterfall.

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu have fun playing hide and seek with a dragon in a magical castle.

babytv.uk.title: Lale Ki Lolu
babytv.uk.description: Lale and Lolu visit the magical world of ancient Egypt with it's hieroglyphics, pyramids and colossal statues all bursting with the playfulness. S1 Ep6

babytv.uk.title: Travelers
babytv.uk.description: It's not easy falling asleep when someone in the room is singing or playing the guitar? What can you do? Join them and have a pajama party!

babytv.uk.title: Pix & Leo
babytv.uk.description: Pix wants to play, but sleepy Leo doesn't want to wake up. No matter how hard Pix tries, Leo is intent on napping. Will Leo finally wake up to play?

babytv.uk.title: Mowgli Welcome to the Jungle
babytv.uk.description: Mowgli and Leela find the perfect muddy mud slide but they can't persuade Gray to join in the fun. Will he be able to overcome his fear?

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: Mama bird builds a nest on Coco for her little chicks but Coco isn't happy with all the commotion. S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Welcome to the island
babytv.uk.description: When mama bird goes to find food for her chicks, the mischievous chicks leave the nest.

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Persia. It's Surp's birthday! Grandma Leila is weaving her grandson a carpet, but it's getting late!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit El Salvador. King Hernandez is always worried and can't sleep!

babytv.uk.title: Mini Matinee
babytv.uk.description: Join the loveable animal friends as they visit Holland. Red flowers grow everywhere and the people love them!

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles a thermometer and band aids! Help fix butterfly's torn wing and see him fly again! S1 Ep1

babytv.uk.title: Mona & Sketch
babytv.uk.description: Join Sketch as he scribbles stars and a spaceship! Help use a fan to sprinkle stardust on a star to make it twinkle! S1 Ep11

babytv.uk.title: Mice Builders
babytv.uk.description: Join the mighty mice builders as they work and play! Come sing along and help them build their new home! What's inside the package? Mustard to spice up food!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bambam throw a birthday party for Dolly's birthday. They have everything you need - balloons, party hats, party blowers and cake of course!

babytv.uk.title: Billy Bam Bam
babytv.uk.description: Billy and Bam find a hungry mouse while enjoying thier picnic. They give it some bread and cheese and then they all play hide and seek!

babytv.uk.title: Bug'n'Play to the Rescue
babytv.uk.description: What a pleasant surprise - there's a rubber duck in the yard! Butterson finds himself stranded in the middle of a puddle on the fubber duck.

babytv.uk.title: Olly
babytv.uk.description: Kitty car breaks down on the way to meet Dolly. Luckily, Olly the tow truck driver is on the way to save the day.

babytv.uk.title: Stitches
babytv.uk.description: Join Needles as he meets his friends in the desert. Come and race with Cloudy, hop with Hoppy and sing along with Lale the Ukulele.

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops Song Series
babytv.uk.description: The Lollipops have fun playing together! Katie on the drums, Beth on the guitar and Jonjon on the piano.

babytv.uk.title: The Lollipops Song Series
babytv.uk.description: Come on everybody - put your hands in the air and say "I love rock"! Join the Lollipops as they celebrate music S1 Ep3

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Stop what you're doing and take a break - with Drake! Shimme your shoulders, bend you knees - now your hips and shake shake, shake!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: If you have a mouse near your house why don't you try dancing with it? Wiggle your tail and start sniffing!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Wag your tail and put up your paws - come dance like a cat. Don't forget "Meow"!

babytv.uk.title: Giggle Wiggle
babytv.uk.description: Get ready to rumble in the jungle with an elephant! Flap your ears, stomp your feet and blow the trumpet!

babytv.uk.title: Songs & Rhymes
babytv.uk.description: Draco has fun ice skating with Billy and Bambam, a snowman and a Christmas tree.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie as he helps Number Seven find musicians for a seven-member orchestra before they all set out to have fun singing and dancing.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Numbers
babytv.uk.description: Join Charlie as he tries to help Number Eight find eight sheep that disappeared from his story with the help of a surprise friend-the green dragon.

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: Charlie and Circle play hide and seek. Circle is very good at hiding, will Charlie be able to find him?

babytv.uk.title: Charlie & the Shapes
babytv.uk.description: All aboard! Captain Trapezoid and Charlie are going sailing. Oh no! Captain Trapezoid has forgotten his sails.

"It's a Mann's World" provides fans a view of the couple behind the camera -- at home, attending exclusive events, and spending time with famous friends. The hourlong episodes show how David and Tamela balance being celebrities, entrepreneurs and parents to four adult children while maintaining their marriage of 20-plus years. (Reality) - 2015-01-14

cinemax.us.title: Horizon: An American Saga: Chapter 1
cinemax.us.description: In 1859 families discover the lure of the Old West as they settle in territories from Wyoming to Kansas. Meanwhile, a gruff cowboy soon finds himself on the run with a prostitute and a young boy after killing a fellow gunman. (Western, Drama) - 2024

cinemax.us.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
cinemax.us.description: It's open season on Harley Quinn when her explosive breakup with the Joker puts a big fat target on her back. Unprotected and on the run, Quinn faces the wrath of narcissistic crime boss Black Mask, his right-hand man, Victor Zsasz, and every other thug in the city. But things soon even out for Harley when she becomes unexpected allies with three deadly women -- Huntress, Black Canary and Renee Montoya. (Action, Comedy) - 2020

cinemax.us.title: The Shape of Water
cinemax.us.description: Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank. (Fantasy, Drama, Romance, Science fiction) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
cinemax.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: The Whistlers
cinemax.us.description: A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera. (Comedy drama, Thriller) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
cinemax.us.description: In 1770 the young daughter of a French countess develops a mutual attraction to the female artist commissioned to paint her wedding portrait. (Historical drama, LGBTQ, Drama) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: Joshy
cinemax.us.description: Four months after the suicide of his fiancée (Alison Brie), a man (Thomas Middleditch) and his buddies (Adam Pally, Alex Ross Perry) decide to move forward with plans for a wild bachelor party. (Comedy drama) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Aniara
cinemax.us.description: When a spacecraft carrying settlers to Mars strays off course, the consumption-obsessed passengers are prompted to consider their place in the universe. (Science fiction, Drama) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Judy
cinemax.us.description: Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Jazz) - 2019

cinemax.us.title: My Blind Brother
cinemax.us.description: Bill has always lived in the shadow of his overachieving brother Robbie, an arrogant athlete and local celebrity who happens to be blind. After years of thanklessly helping Robbie achieve one goal after another, Bill finally catches a break when he finds a connection with the charming Rose, who is dealing with her own crisis. But when Rose starts dating Robbie, Bill must decide if he can finally put his own happiness over his brother's and compete for the ultimate prize. (Romantic comedy) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
cinemax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

cinemax.us.title: Blair Witch
cinemax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

cinemax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
cinemax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

cinemax.us.title: Extraction
cinemax.us.description: A government analyst (Kellan Lutz) launches his own rescue mission when terrorists kidnap his father (Bruce Willis), a retired CIA operative. (Thriller, Action) - 2015

cinemax.us.title: Full Metal Jacket
cinemax.us.description: Stanley Kubrick's take on the Vietnam War follows smart-aleck Private Davis (Matthew Modine), quickly christened "Joker" by his foul-mouthed drill sergeant (R. Lee Ermey), and pudgy Private Lawrence (Vincent D'Onofrio), nicknamed "Gomer Pyle," as they endure the rigors of basic training. Though Pyle takes a frightening detour, Joker graduates to the Marine Corps and is sent to Vietnam as a journalist, covering -- and eventually participating in -- the bloody Battle of Hue. (War, Historical drama) - 1987

cinemax.us.title: The East
cinemax.us.description: Sarah, an undercover agent at a private intelligence firm, is hired to infiltrate the East, an ecoterrorism cell targeting companies that pollute the environment. Though one of the group's hardcore members is suspicious of her, Sarah manages to win over Benji, the East's leader. However -- even as Sarah tries to maintain her cover -- she gains more sympathy for the group's cause while, increasingly, becoming drawn to Benji. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Grudge Match
cinemax.us.description: Pittsburgh boxers Billy "The Kid" McDonnen (Robert De Niro) and Henry "Razor" Sharp (Sylvester Stallone) shared a fierce rivalry back in the 1980s. Each had scored a victory in two matches, but on the eve of their decisive third bout, Henry suddenly announced his retirement, effectively ending both boxers' careers. Thirty years later, boxing promoter Dante Slate Jr. (Kevin Hart) makes Billy and Henry an offer they can't refuse: Return to the ring and settle the score once and for all. (Comedy) - 2013

cinemax.us.title: Wedding Crashers
cinemax.us.description: Jeremy (Vince Vaughn) and John (Owen Wilson) are divorce mediators who spend their free time crashing wedding receptions. For the irrepressible duo, there are few better ways to drink for free and bed vulnerable women. So when Secretary of the Treasury William Cleary (Christopher Walken) announces the wedding of his daughter, the pair make it their mission to crash the high-profile event. But their game hits a bump in the road when John locks eyes with bridesmaid Claire (Rachel McAdams). (Romantic comedy) - 2005

cinemax.us.title: Super Troopers 2
cinemax.us.description: Fired for their previous shenanigans, former Vermont Highway Patrol officers Thorny, Farva, Rabbit, Foster and Mac get a shot at redemption from Capt. O'Hagan and Gov. Jessan. The wacky quintet must provide law enforcement for a French Canadian town that's transitioning to U.S. sovereignty. Their unconventional methods soon get put to the test when they encounter a smarmy mayor, mischievous Mounties, a smuggling ring and a 1,300-pound bear. (Comedy) - 2018

cinemax.us.title: Happy Death Day
cinemax.us.description: Tree Gelbman is a blissfully self-centered collegian who wakes up on her birthday in the bed of a student named Carter. As the morning goes on, Tree gets the eerie feeling that she's experienced the events of this day before. When a masked killer suddenly takes her life in a brutal attack, she once again magically wakes up in Carter's dorm room unharmed. Now, the frightened young woman must relive the same day over and over until she figures out who murdered her. (Horror, Thriller, Comedy, Mystery) - 2017

cinemax.us.title: Scream
cinemax.us.description: The sleepy little town of Woodsboro just woke up screaming. There's a killer in their midst who's seen a few too many scary movies. Suddenly nobody is safe, as the psychopath stalks victims, taunts them with trivia questions, then rips them to bloody shreds. It could be anybody. (Horror, Comedy) - 1996

cinemax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
cinemax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's 11
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean (Frank Sinatra) calls on some of his World War II buddies -- including Jimmy Foster (Peter Lawford), Sam Harmon (Dean Martin) and Josh Howard (Sammy Davis Jr.) -- to pull off an elaborate New Year's Eve heist at five casinos in Las Vegas. Eleven members of Danny's crew come together to pull off a perfect robbery, but they suffer a series of setbacks when Duke Santos (Cesar Romero), a former gangster, tries to thwart Ocean's plans to disappear with the money. (Comedy drama) - 1960

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
cinemax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
cinemax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

cinemax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
cinemax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

cinemax.us.title: Walk the Line
cinemax.us.description: The rise of country music legend Johnny Cash (Joaquin Phoenix) begins with his days as a boy growing up on the family farm, where he struggles under the scorn of his father (Robert Patrick). As the years pass, Cash ends up in Memphis, Tenn., with his wife, Vivian (Ginnifer Goodwin), and breaks into the music scene after finding his trademark sound. While on tour, Cash meets the love of his life, singer June Carter (Reese Witherspoon), but Cash's volatile lifestyle threatens to keep them apart. (Biography, Historical drama, Music, Country, Rock) - 2005

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Hitcher
cinemaxaction.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Action, Horror, Movie, Thriller) - 1986-05-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Darkest Minds
cinemaxaction.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Action, Adventure, Drama, Movie, Romance) - 2018-08-03

cinemaxaction.us.title: Holla
cinemaxaction.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Comedy, Horror, Movie) - 2006

cinemaxaction.us.title: My Soul to Take
cinemaxaction.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Movie, Mystery, Thriller) - 2010-10-08

cinemaxaction.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Comedy, Fantasy, Horror, Movie) - 2024-08-28

cinemaxaction.us.title: Collision Course
cinemaxaction.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie) - 1989

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1972-03-12

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura). (Action, Horror, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1971-07-24

cinemaxaction.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
cinemaxaction.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Action, Adventure, Movie, Science Fiction, Science fiction) - 1973-03-17

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Usual Suspects
cinemaxaction.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Crime, Crime drama, Drama, Movie, Thriller) - 1995-08-16

cinemaxaction.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
cinemaxaction.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Action, Adventure, Children, Comedy, Family) - 1992

cinemaxaction.us.title: Game Night
cinemaxaction.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Action, Comedy, Crime, Movie, Mystery) - 2018-02-23

cinemaxaction.us.title: The Apparition

The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. When the Whos decide to make Christmas bigger and brighter, the disgruntled Grinch realizes there is one way to gain peace and quiet. With help from Max, the green grump hatches a scheme to pose as Santa Claus, steal Christmas and silence the Whos' holiday cheer once and for all. (Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2018

freeform.us.title: The Santa Clause

After he accidentally kills a man in a Santa suit, they are magically transported to the North Pole, where an elf explains that Scott must take Santa's place before the next Christmas arrives. Scott thinks he's dreaming, but over the next several months he gains weight and grows an inexplicably white beard. Maybe that night at the North Pole wasn't a dream after all -- and maybe Scott has a lot of work to do. (Family, Holiday, Comedy) - 1994

Each episode features two pairs of competitors, sometimes from a particular rivalry -- for example, UCLA vs. USC or Trekkies vs."Star Wars" fans -- participating in several rounds of simple, rapid-fire questions testing people's observational skills, attention to detail, and general knowledge. The winning pair takes home the money earned in the game and plays the bonus round, where even more cash is up for grabs. Comic Ben Gleib hosts the show that isn't afraid to call its players idiots. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140812

gameshowcentral.us.description: Contestants on this dating game show don't want to hear the elimination line "I'm sorry, but you have too much baggage." gameshowcentral.us.title: Mind of a Man
gameshowcentral.us.description: Women have been trying to answer the question of "what do men think" for years. "Mind of a Man" tries to help them figure out what is on the mind of the average guy. Each half-hour episode pits two female contestants against each other as they try to correctly answer questions asked of 100 men. Helping the women along the way is a rotating celebrity panel composed of a mix of men and women who offer opinions. The contestant who is more successful in understanding the mind of a man wins the game and advances to the bonus round, in which she can amass up to $10,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20140108

gameshowcentral.us.title: Divided
gameshowcentral.us.description: Veteran game show host and producer Mike Richards emcees this show that is described as "part game show, part social experiment." Four strangers must work as a team on each episode, coming to an agreement on the answer to each question Richards asks. They have to do it quickly, though, because as the clock ticks down so does the amount of money the contestants can win. So the longer they debate, the less a correct answer earns them. As the amount of money available increases in each round, the intensity ramps up as there is a point when the team must collectively decide on one member to eliminate. At the end of the game, whatever money has been won to that point is divided into three highly uneven amounts and the three remaining players have to decide who gets which portion of the cash. They find themselves on the clock again as they attempt to come to a consensus on that decision. If the time runs out before settling on a solution, they lose everything. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20161125

gameshowcentral.us.title: Minute to Win It
gameshowcentral.us.description: As a speed skater, Apolo Anton Ohno won a gold medal at the 2006 Winter Olympics for finishing a race within 42 seconds. The contestants on this game show hosted by Ohno have 18 seconds longer than that to complete each task in order to win a quarter of a million dollars as the grand prize. Contestants compete in as many as 10 challenges of increasing difficulty, each with a one-minute time limit, and which utilize everyday household items. Throughout the game contestants have the chance to walk away with any money earned to that point but risk losing the cash if they fail to complete a challenge within the time limit. A competitor who goes all the way and completes all 10 challenges in time, receives the $250,000. (Show, Series, Game show) - 20130625

golfpass.us.title: The Smylie Show

golfpass.us.title: GolfPass Top Tips - Short Game
golfpass.us.description: The top tips from the world's best teachers have been compiled to improve your short game; Devan Bonebrake reveals how to make perfect chipping contact, Aimee Cho teaches how a towel can improve your pitch shots and Martin Hall is featured.

golfpass.us.title: GolfPass Top Tips - Bunker Play
golfpass.us.description: The top tips from the world's best teachers have been compiled to help you out of greenside bunkers; Devan Bonebrake shares Jordan Spieth's sand secret, Nathalie Sheehan teaches a unique grip for bunker shots and James Oh is featured.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Playing in the Wind - Playing Downwind and Into the Wind
golfpass.us.description: Nick Dougherty breaks down the art of playing downwind and into the wind. Nick will guide you through techniques to maximize distance, control trajectory, and adjust your club selection to take full advantage of the wind.

golfpass.us.title: Golfer's Guide: Playing in the Wind - Right to Left Left to Right
golfpass.us.description: Nick Dougherty teaches techniques and tips for achieving excellent golf performance when playing into the wind. He shows how to maximize distance, control trajectory, and adjust club selection to make the most of the weather conditions.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Swing Checkpoints, Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Debbie Doniger is here to go through the checkpoints of the golf swing -- from the setup to the top of the backswing. She's got individualized tips and drills for each position to help golfers play their best golf and own their swing.

golfpass.us.title: Build a Better Game - Swing Checkpoints, Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Debbie Doniger is back to go through the rest of the checkpoints of the swing -- from the transition through impact. Plus, with this newfound knowledge, she'll help put all the checkpoints together to have golfers swinging their best in no time.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Classic Algarve
golfpass.us.description: At Salgados in the Algarve, Chris plays the seventh hole, a par 4, and enjoys an afternoon in the sunshine as he takes on the palm-lined course.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Ocean and Estuary
golfpass.us.description: Chris and Paul play the 16th hole at the Royal course at Vale do Lobo, a famous course in Portugal.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Algarve to Lisbon
golfpass.us.description: Paul and Chris play the 18th hole at Quinta do Lago Laranjal in the Algarve, the newest of the three courses at Quinta do Lago.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - Cascais and Coastlines
golfpass.us.description: Paul and Chris play the sixth hole, a dogleg par 4, at a hilltop course in Lisbon, Portugal, at Penha Longa in the Cascais area.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Dunes and Debuts
golfpass.us.description: Paul and Chris play the 14th hole in Aroeira near Lisbon, Portugal, a course that Paul knows well from playing the Portuguese Open.

golfpass.us.title: Golf's Greatest Holes - Portugal - A Fitting Finale
golfpass.us.description: Chris plays the 18th hole, a par 4, on a misty day at a course in West Cliffs, an hour's drive north of Lisbon, Portugal.

golfpass.us.title: Ask Rory - Masters Edition Volume 1

golfpass.us.description: The 12 competitors arrive and are immediately faced with a challenge that they've never experienced before.

golfpass.us.description: A dispute erupts among competitors.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Turn a Blind Eye
golfpass.us.description: A shocking turn of events leads to a completely unexpected matchup in the elimination challenge.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Decisions, Decisions
golfpass.us.description: A surprising performance from one of the competitors turns the already unpredictable competition completely upside down.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Three's a Crowd
golfpass.us.description: One competitor starts to frustrate with spectacular play, and a weakness is detected in one of the favorites.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Be Like Brittany
golfpass.us.description: A controversial comment and reaction during the immunity challenge leads to serious backlash.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - Cutting It Close
golfpass.us.description: The pressure of competition begins to wear down one competitor, and great play is attributed to luck.

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - A Fine Line

golfpass.us.title: The Big Break - 20,000 Ways to Win

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Xander & Stefan Schauffele
golfpass.us.description: Instructor Chris Como is on a journey to explore golf's leading teachers and influencers who are shaping the game for future generations. Como travels the world in search of the culture, philosophy, and technology of successful players and coaches.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - David Leadbetter
golfpass.us.description: David Leadbetter demonstrates the drills and techniques he taught Nick Faldo before he won six major championships. Leadbetter also reveals how to perfectly grip the club and the technology he trusts when teaching his students.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Bryson DeChambeau - Building His Swing
golfpass.us.description: Chris travels to Dallas National Golf Club and spends a day with multiple-time PGA Tour winner Bryson DeChambeau and his long-time coach, Mike Schy. Bryson explains the origin of his single-length clubs and the mechanics he learned at a young age.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Course Management with Scott Fawcett
golfpass.us.description: Chris Como travels to Texas and learns the course management strategies Scott Fawcett teaches through a combination of shot distribution patterns and PGA scoring stats. Learn where to aim off the tee and which type of shot to play out of trouble.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Randy Smith & Scottie Scheffler
golfpass.us.description: Masters champion Scottie Scheffler gives Chris an inside look alongside longtime coach Randy Smith.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Claude Harmon III - Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Claude Harmon III presents an analogy for the golf swing to help with proper sequencing.

golfpass.us.title: Swing Expedition With Chris Como - Claude Harmon III - Part 2
golfpass.us.description: Claude Harmon III discusses concepts he has learned from working with some of the best players in the world.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Power Play
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick talks about the underlying principle of distance -- clubhead speed -- and the keys to gaining more distance with the driver. McCormick also explains and demonstrates range of motion and speed development.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Takeoff
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick, the 2015 PGA Teacher of the Year and coach to three-time major champion Jordan Spieth, unlocks the secrets to building a championship-caliber golf game.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Use the Force
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick brings you inside his lab to scientifically prove how ground forces affect the golf swing. McCormick explains how to achieve maximum power with the lead leg and how to move properly through the swing with the trail leg.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Fore Right
golfpass.us.description: The most common problem for amateur golfers is the slice. Cameron McCormick, the 2015 PGA Teacher of the Year, tackles this issue by explaining how club delivery with the face and path dictates curve.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Snake in the Grass
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick moves to the putting green to teach the best strategies to making more putts and conquering the dreaded yips. McCormick explains the importance of the start line and how to gain control of the putter face for optimal control.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Foundation and Coordination for Juniors
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick, the 2015 PGA Teacher of the Year, unlocks the secrets to building a championship-caliber golf game.

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Tour Shots
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick teaches the what and how behind the score-saving shots that amaze people who watch professional golf. Specialty shots take center stage as viewers learn how to execute the "Skid Spinner," "Super Flop," and the "Banker.".

golfpass.us.title: The Skill Code - The Playbook - Mission Impossible
golfpass.us.description: Cameron McCormick demonstrates how to execute difficult fairway bunker shots, dreaded mid-range bunker shots, and buried bunker lies.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Kris Ventura
golfpass.us.description: 2019 NCAA National Championship winner and 2021 PGA TOUR rookie Kris Ventura shares the tips and strategies that have led to his success. Ventura goes in depth on his green reading and putting strategy, which begins before he steps onto the green.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Camilo Villegas
golfpass.us.description: Discover the strategies and techniques that work for them on the big stage and see what you can bring back to your own home course.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Daniel Berger
golfpass.us.description: Discover the strategies and techniques that work for them on the big stage and see what you can bring back to your own home course.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Corey Conners
golfpass.us.description: PGA Tour winner Corey Conners joins Bones on the course to share his tips and strategies that have led to his amateur and professional success.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Jenny Shin - Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Jim "Bones" Mackay travels to Las Vegas to meet up with LPGA Tour winner Jenny Shin on the course for Part 1 of a 2-part series. Jenny shares her tips and strategies that have led to her LPGA career of over a decade.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Jenny Shin -- Part 2
golfpass.us.description: LPGA Tour winner Jenny Shin joins Bones on the course to share her tips and strategies that have led to her success at the highest level; Jenny explains how she’d play an approach shot differently.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Jake Knapp -- Trouble Shots & Par 5 Management
golfpass.us.description: Jake Knapp analyzes par five shot management, covering tee shot techniques (lower trajectory, subtle fade), green slopes and putting speed.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Jake Knapp -- Handling Drivable Par 4s
golfpass.us.description: Strategies for handling par fours, prioritizing smart decisions over power; evaluate the risk and reward of each shot, and learn specific techniques for tee shots and approaches.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Michael La Sasso -- Part 1
golfpass.us.description: Michael shares his tips and tricks that make him one of golf's brightest young stars; Bones chats with Michael about his path to golf and his future goals.

golfpass.us.title: Playing Lessons - Michael La Sasso -- Part 2

Coupled with missing nuclear scientists and the threat of a nuclear detonation on United States soil, young CIA analyst Jack Ryan (Ben Affleck) must uncover who is behind the conspiracy. (Thriller, Action, Drama, War) - 2002

mgmplus.us.title: Ronin

As their operation gets underway, several team members are found to be untrustworthy, and everyone must complete the mission with a watchful eye on everyone else. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1998

mgmplus.us.title: Roman Holiday
mgmplus.us.description: Overwhelmed by her suffocating schedule, touring European princess Ann takes off for a night while in Rome. When a sedative she took from her doctor kicks in, however, she falls asleep on a park bench and is found by an American reporter, Joe Bradley, who takes her back to his apartment for safety. At work the next morning, Joe finds out Ann's regal identity and bets his editor he can get exclusive interview with her, but romance soon gets in the way. (Romantic comedy) - 1953

mgmplus.us.title: Teen Wolf Too
mgmplus.us.description: Although awkward college student Todd Howard (Jason Bateman) is particularly adept at science, he's paying for school with an athletic scholarship that he will lose should he not fare well in an upcoming boxing tournament. Luckily for Todd, he has inherited the same family curse that once turned his cousin into a werewolf. As he transforms into the hairy, fanged, howling monster, he finds both his physical agility and his popularity skyrocketing -- but at what cost? (Comedy, Fantasy) - 1987

mgmplus.us.title: Back to School
mgmplus.us.description: Thornton Melon (Rodney Dangerfield) is concerned that his son Jason (Keith Gordon) is unsure whether to go to college, so the uneducated self-made millionaire encourages him by signing up as a student as well. As Jason tries to establish himself among his peers and make the diving team, Thornton falls for a pretty professor (Sally Kellerman) and gets others do his schoolwork for him. When the suspicious dean (Paxton Whitehead) finds out, Thornton needs to show he can get by on his own. (Comedy) - 1986

mgmplus.us.title: Boo 2! A Madea Halloween
mgmplus.us.description: Tiffany travels to Derrick Lake to celebrate her 18th birthday at a Halloween frat party in the middle of the woods. Frantic and worried, Madea, Aunt Bam and Hattie hop in the car to save her from the same terrible fate that befell a group of teens there years earlier. Chaos soon strikes when the would-be heroes find themselves fighting for their lives against an array of spooky monsters, goblins and boogeymen. (Holiday, Comedy, Adventure) - 2017

mgmplus.us.title: A Night at the Roxbury
mgmplus.us.description: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own. (Comedy) - 1998

mgmplus.us.title: Ella Enchanted
mgmplus.us.description: As a baby, Ella (Anne Hathaway) receives a visit from Lucinda (Vivica A. Fox), her fairy godmother, and is bestowed with a magical talent that requires her to obey anything that she is told to do. This proves to be more of a curse than a blessing, particularly once her mother dies, and she is forced to live with the cruel Dame Olga (Joanna Lumley). Eventually, Ella embarks on a journey to find Lucinda and break the spell, accompanied by the handsome Prince Charmont (Hugh Dancy). (Children, Romantic comedy, Fantasy, Drama, Adventure) - 2004

mgmplus.us.title: Beauty Shop
mgmplus.us.description: Far from Chicago, hairdresser Gina Norris has relocated to Atlanta with her daughter and has quickly established herself as a rare talent in her profession. But after repeatedly butting heads with her shady, over-the-top boss, Jorge, Norris sets out to create her own salon -- even snagging a few of Jorge's employees and clients, including Lynn and Terri, respectively. Now, Jorge will do anything to shut her down. (Comedy) - 2005

mgmplus.us.title: Boomerang
mgmplus.us.description: A cocky ad executive, Marcus (Eddie Murphy) has a reputation as a ladies' man. However, Marcus gets a taste of his own medicine when a merger finds him working under the beautiful Jacqueline (Robin Givens), who has a similarly cavalier attitude about romance. Marcus and Jacqueline become involved, but he is put off by her noncommittal approach to their relationship. Meanwhile, Marcus also begins to develop feelings for the pretty Angela (Halle Berry), who is more thoughtful than Jacqueline. (Romantic comedy) - 1992

mgmplus.us.title: The American President
mgmplus.us.description: With the end of his first term in sight, widowed U.S. President Andrew Shepherd (Michael Douglas) knows that overwhelming public support will guarantee his re-election. But when he falls in love with lobbyist Sydney Ellen Wade (Annette Bening), Shepherd's supporters question the relationship, and his approval ratings drop. As a rival presidential candidate goes on the attack, Shepherd must choose between his political career and his love for Sydney. (Romance, Comedy drama) - 1995

mgmplus.us.title: Overboard
mgmplus.us.description: Snobbish and wealthy Joanna Stayton is living a life of leisure with her husband, Grant, when she falls off their yacht and suffers amnesia. Grant takes the opportunity to rid himself of the demanding Joanna -- but Dean, a widowed carpenter with four kids who once worked for Joanna, arrives and claims she's his wife. Joanna can't remember her past identity, but has trouble believing that she was ever meant to be a working-class mother of four. (Comedy, Romance) - 1987

J.C.'s life takes an unexpected turn when a relative suddenly dies and makes her the caretaker of a baby girl. Soon, the baby's arrival causes J.C. to lose first Steven, and then her job. She moves to Vermont and embarks on a series of life-changing events. But when offered the opportunity, will she return to her corporate ways? (Comedy drama, Romance) - 1987

Poncelet begins to form a bond with Prejean, and she visits both his family and the relatives of the victims, hoping to learn more about the case. Against the backdrop of the horrific Battle of Saipan, when capture is imminent, Enders is forced to make a decision: if he can't protect his fellow Marine, can he bring himself to kill him to protect the code? mgmplushits.us.description: Adapted from the novel by John O'Brien, this acclaimed drama follows alcoholic screenwriter Ben Sanderson (Nicolas Cage) as he drinks himself into oblivion in Las Vegas. When Ben meets the beautiful prostitute Sera (Elisabeth Shue), they strike up an unconventional relationship -- one where she can't ask him to curb his drinking, and he can't fault her for her job. Though they offer each other support, Ben's self-destruction threatens to eclipse their bond. (Drama) - 1995

Oliver finds a job at a legal firm in New York City, but their happy life comes crashing down when it's discovered that Jenny has a terminal illness. Together, they try to cope with the situation as best they can. (Romance, Drama) - 1970

mgmplushits.us.title: An Officer and a Gentleman

Emil Foley (Louis Gossett Jr.), who gives Zack a rude awakening in terms of relating with other people. Through Foley's guidance -- and an unexpected romance with Paula (Debra Winger), an outsider who hangs around the naval base -- Zack learns some tough lessons and discovers what he truly wants out of life. mgmplushits.us.title: Flashdance
