actionmax.us.title: The Hitcher
actionmax.us.description: While transporting a car from Chicago to San Diego, Jim Halsey (C. Thomas Howell) picks up a hitchhiker named John Ryder (Rutger Hauer), who claims to be a serial killer. After a daring escape, Jim hopes to never see Ryder again. But when he witnesses the hitchhiker murdering an entire family, Jim pursues Ryder with the help of truck-stop waitress Nash (Jennifer Jason Leigh), pitting the rivals against each other in a deadly series of car chases and brutal murders. (Thriller) - 1986

actionmax.us.title: The Darkest Minds
actionmax.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: Holla
actionmax.us.description: A mysterious killer stalks a sitcom actress (Shelli Boone) and her companions (Young Sir, Michael Bergin) on a weekend getaway in the wilderness. (Horror) - 2006

actionmax.us.title: My Soul to Take
actionmax.us.description: In the small town of Riverton, a local legend tells of a serial killer's oath to come back and kill the seven children who were born on the night he supposedly died. Now 16 years later, Riverton residents are disappearing again, making some wonder if the legend is true. Bug (Max Thieriot), plagued by nightmares all his life, is one of the so-called Riverton Seven, and it's up to him to save his friends from an evil that will not rest. (Horror, Thriller, Mystery) - 2010

actionmax.us.title: The Blair Witch Project
actionmax.us.description: Found video footage tells the tale of three film students (Heather Donahue, Joshua Leonard, Michael C. Williams) who've traveled to a small town to collect documentary footage about the Blair Witch, a legendary local murderer. Over the course of several days, the students interview townspeople and gather clues to support the tale's veracity. But the project takes a frightening turn when the students lose their way in the woods and begin hearing horrific noises. (Horror, Thriller) - 1999

actionmax.us.title: Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2
actionmax.us.description: As it follows the twisted path traveled by five people fixated on "The Blair Witch Project," "Book of Shadows: Blair Witch 2" journeys into a dark and dangerous place where the line between truth and fiction blurs and perhaps vanishes altogether. Individual perception grows increasingly untrustworthy as the film's protagonists find themselves caught in a vortex of unspeakable evil, the origins of which -- human or supernatural -- remain chillingly uncertain. (Adventure, Fantasy, Horror) - 2000

actionmax.us.title: Blair Witch
actionmax.us.description: A young man and his friends venture into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland to uncover the mystery surrounding his missing sister. Many believe her disappearance 17 years earlier is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch. At first the group is hopeful, especially when two locals act as guides through the dark and winding woods. As the night wears on, a visit from a menacing presence soon makes them realize that the legend is all too real, and more sinister than they could have ever imagined. (Horror, Thriller) - 2016

actionmax.us.title: Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
actionmax.us.description: Still haunted by Beetlejuice, Lydia's life gets turned upside down when her daughter discovers a portal to the afterlife. When someone says Beetlejuice's name three times, the mischievous demon returns to unleash his very own brand of mayhem. (Fantasy, Horror, Comedy) - 2024

actionmax.us.title: Collision Course
actionmax.us.description: Detroit crime boss Madras hires men to smuggle a top secret, Japanese-made turbocharger into the U.S. But Madras' crooks are murdered, and the turbocharger goes missing. As he searches for the stolen engine, so does straitlaced Tokyo detective Fujitsuka Natsuo. Eventually, local authorities catch wind of the case, and onto the investigation comes brash cop Tony Costas, who must team with his polar opposite, Natsuo, to find the turbocharger. (Action, Comedy) - 1989

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Gigan
actionmax.us.description: Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park. (Science fiction) - 1972

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Hedorah
actionmax.us.description: Godzilla fights pollution in the form of living sludge found by a scientist (Akira Yamauchi) and his son (Toshie Kimura). (Science fiction, Action) - 1971

actionmax.us.title: Godzilla vs. Megalon
actionmax.us.description: Godzilla and flying cyborg Jet Jaguar meet a giant cockroach and a big black chicken sent by Seatopians. (Science fiction) - 1973

actionmax.us.title: The Usual Suspects
actionmax.us.description: "The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist," says con man Kint, drawing a comparison to the most enigmatic criminal of all time, Keyser Söze. Kint attempts to convince the feds that the mythic crime lord not only exists, but is also responsible for drawing Kint and his four partners into a multi-million dollar heist that ended with an explosion in San Pedro Harbor - leaving few survivors. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 1995

actionmax.us.title: Mom and Dad Save the World
actionmax.us.description: While planning to destroy Earth with a gigantic laser beam, Emperor Tod Spengo (Jon Lovitz), ruler of the planet Spengo, catches a glimpse of housewife Marge Nelson (Teri Garr) and becomes smitten with her. Beaming Marge and her husband, Dick (Jeffrey Jones), up to Spengo from California, the daft, dimwitted leader tries to woo her, and sends her spouse to prison. Soon Dick is plotting an insurgency, in hopes of overthrowing Spengo and rescuing his wife. (Children, Science fiction) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Game Night
actionmax.us.description: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night. (Comedy, Action) - 2018

actionmax.us.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
actionmax.us.description: Dr. Steven Murphy is a renowned cardiovascular surgeon who presides over a spotless household with his wife and two children. Lurking at the margins of his idyllic suburban existence is Martin, a fatherless teen who insinuates himself into the doctor's life in gradually unsettling ways. Soon, the full scope of Martin's intent becomes menacingly clear when he confronts Steven with a long-forgotten transgression that will shatter his domestic bliss forever. (Thriller, Horror) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: The Apparition
actionmax.us.description: Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence. (Horror) - 2012

actionmax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
actionmax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Us
actionmax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

actionmax.us.title: Companion
actionmax.us.description: A weekend getaway at a remote cabin turns to chaos when it's revealed that one of the guests -- a subservient android built for human companionship -- has gone haywire. (Thriller, Science fiction, Horror, Dark comedy) - 2025

actionmax.us.title: Meg 2: The Trench
actionmax.us.description: Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action, Adventure) - 2023

actionmax.us.title: Megan Leavey
actionmax.us.description: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy. (War, Biography, Drama) - 2017

actionmax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
actionmax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

actionmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
actionmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

actionmax.us.title: Ghidorah, the Three-Headed Monster
actionmax.us.description: Godzilla, Rodan and Mothra team up to save mankind from the deadliest threat of all -- a fire-breathing space monster. (Science fiction) - 1964

actionmax.us.title: Batman
actionmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

actionmax.us.title: Batman Returns
actionmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

actionmax.us.title: Batman Forever
actionmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

actionmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
actionmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

moremax.us.title: Leave No Trace
moremax.us.description: A father and daughter live a perfect but mysterious existence in Forest Park, a beautiful nature reserve near Portland, Ore., rarely making contact with the world. But when a small mistake tips them off to authorities, they are sent on an increasingly erratic journey in search of a place to call their own. (Drama) - 2018

moremax.us.title: A History of Violence
moremax.us.description: When a pair of petty criminals attempt to rob his small-town diner, Tom Stall (Viggo Mortensen) quickly and easily kills them both. In the flush of news coverage of Tom's seemingly heroic actions, a threatening stranger named Carl Fogarty (Ed Harris) comes to town, fingering the unassuming family man as long-missing Philadelphia mobster Joey Cusack. To the horror of his wife, Edie (Maria Bello), and teenage son, Jack (Ashton Holmes), Tom finds he must confront his violent past. (Drama, Thriller) - 2005

moremax.us.title: The Nun
moremax.us.description: When a young nun at a cloistered abbey in Romania takes her own life, a priest with a haunted past and a novitiate on the threshold of her final vows are sent by the Vatican to investigate. Together, they uncover the order's unholy secret. Risking not only their lives but their faith and their very souls, they confront a malevolent force in the form of a demonic nun. (Horror, Thriller) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Us
moremax.us.description: Accompanied by her husband, son and daughter, Adelaide Wilson returns to the beachfront home where she grew up as a child. Haunted by a traumatic experience from the past, Adelaide grows increasingly concerned that something bad is going to happen. Her worst fears soon become a reality when four masked strangers descend upon the house, forcing the Wilsons into a fight for survival. When the masks come off, the family is horrified to learn that each attacker takes the appearance of one of them. (Horror, Thriller) - 2019

moremax.us.title: 3 Days to Kill
moremax.us.description: Facing a terminal disease, spy Ethan Renner (Kevin Costner) has decided to give up his dangerous, high-stakes life in order to rebuild his relationship with his estranged wife and daughter (Hailee Steinfeld), whom he previously pushed away to keep them out of harm's way. However, in exchange for a potentially lifesaving drug, he must complete one final mission: apprehend one of the world's most ruthless terrorists while looking after his teenage offspring in her mother's absence. (Action, Thriller, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: Enemy
moremax.us.description: A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs. (Thriller) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Inconceivable
moremax.us.description: Angela develops a friendship with a mysterious woman named Katie and offers her a job as a live-in nanny. The natural bond soon turns into a dangerous obsession as Katie becomes overly attached to the family's young daughter. Enduring lies and manipulations, Angela and her husband realize that sweet Katie is actually trying to destroy their family from within. (Thriller, Drama) - 2017

moremax.us.title: My Dead Dad
moremax.us.description: Young burnout Lucas is notified that his estranged father has passed away and has left him an apartment complex in Los Angeles. Lucas meets the eclectic tenants, and soon discovers his father was a different man than the one he knew. (Drama) - 2021

moremax.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
moremax.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

moremax.us.title: The Flash
moremax.us.description: Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2023

moremax.us.title: Mickey 17
moremax.us.description: A disposable employee is sent on a human expedition to colonize the ice world Niflheim. After one iteration dies, a new body is regenerated with most of his memories intact. (Science fiction, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Opus
moremax.us.description: A journalist is invited to the remote compound of a legendary pop star who mysteriously disappeared 30 years ago. Surrounded by the star's cult of sycophants, she gets caught in the middle of his twisted plan. (Thriller, Horror, Comedy) - 2025

moremax.us.title: Due Date
moremax.us.description: Peter Highman will be a dad for the first time when his wife gives birth in five days. He intends to catch a flight home from Atlanta so he can be there for the delivery, but a chance encounter with aspiring actor Ethan Tremblay throws a monkey wrench into his plans. Desperate to reach his wife before their baby is born, Peter's sanity is tested when he must take a road trip cross-country with dog-toting Ethan. (Dark comedy, Comedy drama) - 2010

moremax.us.title: The Internship
moremax.us.description: After old-school salesmen Billy and Nick find themselves downsized, Billy decides that, despite their complete lack of technological savvy, they should work for Google. The friends somehow manage to finagle internships at the Internet giant and promptly head out to Silicon Valley. Viewed with disdain by most of their fellow interns, Billy and Nick join forces with the rest of the misfit "nooglers" to make it through a series of competitive team challenges. (Comedy) - 2013

moremax.us.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
moremax.us.description: Cal Weaver (Steve Carell) is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily (Julianne Moore). Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer (Ryan Gosling), a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies. (Romantic comedy) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Joker
moremax.us.description: Forever alone in a crowd, failed comedian Arthur Fleck seeks connection as he walks the streets of Gotham City. Arthur wears two masks -- the one he paints for his day job as a clown, and the guise he projects in a futile attempt to feel like he's part of the world around him. Isolated, bullied and disregarded by society, Fleck begins a slow descent into madness as he transforms into the criminal mastermind known as the Joker. (Crime drama) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Joker: Folie à Deux
moremax.us.description: Struggling with his dual identity, failed comedian Arthur Fleck stumbles upon true love while incarcerated at Arkham State Hospital. Awaiting trial for the murder of five people, Fleck soon discovers the music that's always been inside him. (Musical, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2024

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Eleven
moremax.us.description: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2001

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Twelve
moremax.us.description: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2004

moremax.us.title: Ocean's Thirteen
moremax.us.description: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties. (Comedy drama, Crime drama) - 2007

moremax.us.title: Lord of the Flies
moremax.us.description: Amidst a nuclear war, a plane carrying a group of schoolboys crash lands on a deserted island. With no adult survivors, the boys are forced to fend for themselves. At first, they cooperate, but when they split into two separate camps -- one led by the pragmatic Ralph (James Aubrey) and the other by militaristic Jack (Tom Chapin) -- their society falls into disarray, leading to a disturbing examination of human nature and a chilling conclusion. (Drama, Adventure, Thriller) - 1963

moremax.us.title: The Darkest Minds
moremax.us.description: When teens mysteriously develop powerful new abilities, they are declared a threat by the government and detained. One of the most powerful young people, Ruby, escapes from her camp and joins a group of runaways who are seeking a safe haven. Betrayed by the adults in power, this newfound family soon realizes that running is not enough -- they must use their collective powers to wage a resistance and take back their future. (Science fiction, Thriller, Action) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Enter Nowhere
moremax.us.description: Three strangers arrive one at a time in a remote cabin, and learn they have been brought together for a reason. (Drama, Horror, Mystery, Thriller) - 2011

moremax.us.title: Rampage
moremax.us.description: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe. (Action, Adventure, Science fiction) - 2018

moremax.us.title: Shazam!
moremax.us.description: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2019

moremax.us.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
moremax.us.description: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world. (Action, Adventure, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2023

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura teams up with vegetable guru Catherine Velisha to create wonderful Prawn Dumplings, with spring onions as the hero ingredient. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Chicken Parm Patty Melts
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael puts a bold Italian spin on a classic patty melt with her chicken parmesan version, loaded with Italian seasoning, topped with mozzarella and provolone. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura brings her young nephew Noah on the show and together they make cookies. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Barbecue
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie has a genius barbeque day as he cooks up everything from shellfish to lamb, chicken, ribs and even onions on the barbeque. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Think yoghurt is too hard to make yourself from scratch? Think again, Justine's mum shows you just how easy it is on today's episode of Everyday Gourmet. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - Dinner SOS
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Adam and his guests, powerhouse hospitality duo Martin Benn and Vicki Wild, answer the dinner SOS distress call. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mary Makes It Easy - Casserole With It
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nothing says comfort food like casserole, and Mary's got a variation for any time of the day, even breakfast and dessert! (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Prepare The Harvest
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Harvest time starts in late August in Italy, and it is one of the most important celebrations in the culture! Lidia celebrates with her oat risotto, makes olive-oil cake and red wine poached pears. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - Cheeses Of Quebec
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The Canadian province of Quebec is undergoing a cheese-making revival. Will visits Quebec to find out whether the original French settlers have had any influence on this renaissance. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Small Spaces Big Flavor
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Buddy heads to two small restaurants with huge reputations for making delicious food. First up is DiFara Pizza in Brooklyn, New York to learn the secrets to their famous slice. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera - Finale Ligure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luana cooks on one of the town's most beautiful beaches, harvests basil beneath the waves, meets Anna, an artist inspired by the surrounding landscapes and discovers one of the region’s finest honeys. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Tornedalen, Sweden
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: There are not many places in Sweden like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen - Chilli Crab With Tamarind, Chicken Vermicelli Mushroom, Marinated Pearl Shell Meat Salad
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Kriol Kitchen hosts with Adam Liaw. Adam is a cook, writer and presenter of The Cook Up With Adam Liaw. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Old Favourites
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Maggie and Simon bring back some Old Favourites and, of course, reveal secrets that take your cooking to another level. Inspired by tradition and a gift of a pot from his Mum. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura is in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, creating a winter warmer: Mushroom Pies. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Pesto Pasta & Chicken Cutlet
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael brings the flavour with her Lemon Lover's Chicken Cutlets and Pesto Pasta. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Luca Ciano delivers the ultimate in recipe inspiration with his fresh and original Italian style creations. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays - Cheese Fondue With Vegetables, Sausage And Beef Tips
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Impress your holiday guests with a cheesy classic fondue party! Rachael shows how to make her version of an easy and decadent 'Fundue' that is sure to bring everyone around the table. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Wendy joins Laura as they make a Swedish potato pudding; Tobie makes tiramisu; Catherine cooks spring onion in the form of a chip; Simone prepares delicious rice paper rolls. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Beans
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: The beautiful British summer-time sees Jamie getting a thorough soaking as he picks the beans in his garden. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: There are some great recipes shared on today's episode including; Roast Duck, Peanut & Glass Noodle Salad, Cucumber and Mint Gazpacho with Sour Cream, and Mango and Passionfruit Cheesecakes. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Great Australian Pub Meal
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Jacqui Challinor and actor Dave Lawson join Adam to make great Australian pub meals at home. And they won't even charge you extra for sauce. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Justine prepares a dish at Little Miss Korea, takes a plunge in the Crocasauras Cove and checks out Darwin's nightlife at The Trader Bar with a Green Ant Cocktail. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: A Girl's Guide to Hunting, Fishing and Wild Cooking - New & Old Friends
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Analiese faces her biggest challenge yet, slaughtering the two pigs she's reared for meat, and is visited by old friends from the mainland who reaffirm her commitment to her new life. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: High Country Farm - Risky Cropping
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Nadia and Carlos tackle the crop that Royalburn is most famous for barley, but they branch out with a bold experiment to grow 5 million sunflowers on the upper paddocks of the Crown Terrace. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Mary. Loves. Soup. Join the soup obsession with recipes that vary from cozy to chill, smooth or chunky, plus an ample dose of cheese, duh. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Salt Your Pasta Water!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's pasta time again, so don't forget to salt the pasta water, and sauce your pasta the way the Italians do! Lidia prepares a pasta primavera, then a cavatappi with asparagus and spinach pesto. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Cheese Slices - The Ancient Cheese Of Portugal
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Until recently, Portugal's traditional ewe's milk cheeses were rarely found outside the country. Will travels to the rugged mountains of the north to find out more about the king of Portuguese cheese. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Legends Of The Fork - Bringing The Heat
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: We're turning up the heat! Buddy visits two iconic hotspots who are famous for their intensely spicy dishes. First, he heads to Jitlada in Los Angeles, California to see if he can withstand the heat. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Dolce Vita Riviera - Monte Carlo Noel
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luana takes us behind the scenes of the Principality's most iconic landmarks, including Casino Square, the Cafe de Paris, and the kitchens of the Hotel Hermitage Monte-Carlo. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery - Nordjylland, Denmark
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen - Lemon Grass And Soya Turtle, Shellfish Stir-Fry Noodle, Susami
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Bundy runs his own Cultural Tours business out of Chile Creek near the communities of Djarindjin and Lombadina. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook And The Chef - Winter Comfort Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: It's time to shake off the winter blues with a serve of piping hot comfort food. This mid-winter episode dishes up some warming, homely treats - and reveals why Simon still bears the mental scars. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Laura visits the wonderful Adelaide Central Markets and cooks up an Asian-inspired Kingfish Sashimi with Nahm Jim. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes - Bacon Jack Burger
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael shares her secrets for the ultimate Bacon Jack Burger, from scoring the meat for perfect portions to packing equal amounts of crispy bacon into every bite. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luca's Key Ingredient
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: This episode celebrates saffron, one of the world's most prized ingredients. Luca begins with a golden, fragrant risotto, follows with a refined pasta dish that lets saffron truly shine. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray's Holidays - Vegetarian Feast
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Rachael shows how to prepare a show-stopping, meat-free holiday meal that everyone will love! First, she makes a rich and flavourful pumpkin soup using Italian pumpkins. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Things get dicey after Laura is inspired by in-season passionfruit at the market and decides to make a passionfruit sponge cake. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home - Onions
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Jamie pulls up some of his first onions of the year and makes a crisp and fresh cheese and onion salad. The red onions he uses in an onion and potato al forno with tender roast pork. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Hong Kong Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Justine shows you around Macao on today's episode and shows off her Chicken and Asian Mushroom Fricassee Stew with a view! (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw - The Italian Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Chef Giovanni Pilu and author Julia Busuttil Nishimura join Adam for a night of Easy Entertaining at The Italian Table. (Special Interest)

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella's Cook, Eat, Repeat Christmas - Nigella's Cook, Eat, Repeat Christmas Special

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S11 E35 Floating Market The playgroup is hosting a floating market to raise money. It's a success until Madame Gazelle accidentally drops the money into the lake! Fortunately, Grampy Rabbit retrieves it in his submarine!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E40 Early Baby Bluey's playgroup is at odds when Indy's baby hospital collides with Rusty's knights and dragons. But in explaining themselves, they find their games actually have a lot in common.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Hatchling When an egg cracks to reveal a baby Avocadodon, Ginger and the Pea-Rexes have to find a fun way to lead the energetic baby back to its herd.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E24 The Bestest Beach The cadets pull out all the stops to impress a beach inspector and win the prestigious Bestest Beach Award, all in honour of their dedicated lifeguard heroes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: HexVets And Magic Pets
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 Handle With Bear Annette's baby brother El teaches everyone a lesson when he visits the Clinic.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mojo Swoptops
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E24 Swophenge Nori and Preston are creating a circle of standing stones like the ancients of Swoppiton used to make. But the stones are very big, and it will take more than Mojo's crane top to move them!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Aquatic Adventures
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E29 Andy And The Amazon Cichlid Andy takes to the skies in his safari-mobile, jetting off to the Amazon River in Brazil in search of a rare cichlid fish. Along the way, he has a run-in with a hungry stingray.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E4 Wonderful World 2: Peru Michelle and Rachael discover where Machu Pichu is found on a world globe. Rachael meets Hansel and Victor, a zampona and a charango player, who play Peruvian music and teach Rachael a dance.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fireman Sam
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S16 E14 Kite Catastrophe When Hannah shows off a homemade kite, her stunts cause a barbequing accident, sparking multiple fires!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Zip And The Tiny Sprouts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Ribberto Aria, Riff, and Zip find a friendly frog at the pond! They decide to take him home, but Hum isn't sure their house is the best place for a frog.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Woohoos!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E25 The Spiky Suspect Scotty's bottom gets spiked in big pile of leaves, so the Woohoos play detectives to find out what did it. They find out that hedgehog's curl into spiky balls to protect themselves.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Guess How Much I Love You
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E50 A Hare's Tale Little Nutbrown Hare decides he wants a clever long tail like his friends, rather than a short fluffy one. They help out by making him a long tail but all the results are either too tickly, bendy or flappy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miffy and friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E57 Don't Be Late Grunty is very excited for the school trip; she's never been in a castle before and wants to get going - but it's far too early to meet their friends at the station just yet.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Sound Collector
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E45 Buzzy Business The Sound Collector discovers a bee in the garden. But how will he get it flying again?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Pants' Talent When the town holds a big talent show, Pants struggles to figure out his talent.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: BeddyByes
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E50 Flying Friends MeMo and BaBa enjoy playing with a paper plane and a glider before helping their friends, the Yummies, to do something they've never done before: fly high up in the sky.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mini Kids
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E4 The toddlers are visited by a hamster. Fantus helps a little calf find its parent.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E12 Sticky Gecko Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Dinosaurs GRRRRR. Fizzy and Suds get up close and personal with some pretty cool prehistoric creatures. They meet a model Australovenator, Spinosaurus, and a Triceratops! So come along on a dinosaur adventure!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Pizza Herb Garden Tammy and the junior gardeners plant a pizza shaped herb garden to create the ultimate pizzas!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E4 Wags Is Bored Robert Irwin joins The Wiggles for a special rendition of 'Crocodile Hunter' at Australia Zoo, and amidst the rolly-polly fun, Wags' boredom is solved with the help of Dr Dooby-Doo.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E16 Swarm the IQ Amadeus plans a bioluminescent wave party, but Swarm shows up to cause trouble at the IQ.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mecha Builders
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E1 They Sent Us A Pie A giant pie is sent to Pretty Big City to stop an asteroid.but that discovery is made only after the Mechas and friends have eaten the whole thing!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Thomas & Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Kana Goes Slow When Kana's power goes out during a delivery run, Thomas teaches her that sometimes it's okay to go slow.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E6 Miss Rabbits Relaxation Class Mummy Pig is persuaded by Miss Rabbit to come along to her relaxation class to help Mummy Pig relax but actual relaxing proves to be more challenging than expected.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E6 Parking Ticket When Daddy Pig gets a parking ticket whilst parked in the wrong place, Peppa and George learn that adults have rules too just like children and also get told off too.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Tooth Fairy Bitzer has a terrible toothache, so Shaun turns dentist in an attempt to cure his woes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E2 Hatchling When an egg cracks to reveal a baby Avocadodon, Ginger and the Pea-Rexes have to find a fun way to lead the energetic baby back to its herd.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E48 The Elf Submarine Ben and Holly set out in the Elf Submarine to try and rescue Redbeard the Elf Pirate's sunken treasure. Mr Elf steers the Elf Submarine to the bottom of the lake but before they realise, they are gobbled up by Big Bad Barry.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E39 Cat Years When Flower discovers Flour is \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E21 Flying Piggy Wiggles learns how to fly to free the team from Cat Burglar.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E40 Tina's New Friend While trying to stop Bonnie Bones, Tina accidentally gets separated and makes a new friend in the form of an ancient robot!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E20 Munki-gu In The City The PJ Masks's team spirt falls apart when Munki-gu sabotages their mission with \.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E17 The Octonauts and the Red Rock Crabs Shellington and the others round up some lost crabs and marine iguanas that have been marooned on an island far too cold for them and take them home to the Galapagos Islands.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E35 The Puppy Badge Duggee's nephew Dudley comes to stay. He's one cute puppy, but he looks like he could cause chaos in the clubhouse. The Squirrels come up with lots of imaginative ways to entertain him!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E24 The Bestest Beach The cadets pull out all the stops to impress a beach inspector and win the prestigious Bestest Beach Award, all in honour of their dedicated lifeguard heroes.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S13 E4 Firework Party It's time for the annual Fireworks Night in Pontypandy. The Sparkes learn that the safest way to enjoy fireworks is at the official public display!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Nikhil & Jay
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E45 Nikhil and Jay and the Supervillain After a power cut ruins family movie time, Nikhil and Jay pretend to be superheroes to find the supervillain who took the power!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E1 Your Turn It's time for some bouncy fun as the Numberblobs take over the show. Learn about number lines, comparing numbers and more with the Numberblocks.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Science Time
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E4 Balloon Bonanza How else can you blow up a balloon? Michelle is blowing up balloons for her big balloon party, but she is running out of puff! Bursting with fun facts, this episode shows how gas can blow up balloons.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pop Paper City
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Jurassica Pop On today's poptastic adventure, the friends craft a dinosaur for the Pop Paper City museum. But after their plans go a little wrong, can Zip save the day before the museum's grand opening?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Mittens & Pants
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E34 Carrots, Carrots Everywhere Peppermint the grocer has a lot of carrots. What's more, Monsieur LaFleur is on his way with even MORE. Peppermint doesn't want to disappoint him, so she tries to sell the carrots fast!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Play School
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S367 E4 Solo And Team Sports Time to compete in solo and team sports with Matt and Nicholas! The toys, Little Ted and Kiya, perform impressive rhythmic gymnastics routines. Matt joins Paralympian Dylan Alcott for a game of wheelchair basketball.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Wiggle And Learn
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E24 Episode 24 It's time for catchy tunes and delicious food with The Wiggles! Come along as Simon tries to cook some afternoon tea for The Wiggles, with Captain Feathersword here to help!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Fizzy And Suds
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E26 Fire Trucks Fizzy and Suds explore a fire truck and station! They see gear, practice drills, and ride out on a rescue run. Firefighters carry lots of gear and do many jobs beyond fighting fires!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: L'il Stompers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E49 L'il Leafasaurus DeeDee and Billy discover a new stomper and name it the Leafasaurus. They follow the new dino to find out more about it, and are surprised to learn its true identity.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ginger and the Vegesaurs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E2 Wobbly Tooth Wasabi cracks his tooth on a Lava Nut so Ginger comes up with some creative but unsuccessful ways to extract it, until Wasabi accidentally solves his own problem.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E34 Poisonous! Costa is on a mission to prove that even poisonous plants have their uses and shouldn't be locked up! What plants are poisonous and why? And how do we identify them?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Andy's Wild Workouts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Desert Andy is exploring vast deserts on his latest adventure and he wants you to come along too! He rolls with a dung beetle and runs with an ostrich before meeting, and moving with, the tallest living land mammal, the giraffe.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Santiago of the Seas
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 The Stone Of Life Santi and crew follow a map to a special treasure, but Bonnie and Sir Butterscotch are hot on their trail.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Snow Day It's Bitsy's first snow day, and the team must stop Lab Rat from zapping away all the snow.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Hey Duggee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E13 The Breakfast Badge Tag's feeling grumpy because he didn't eat his breakfast. Luckily Duggee has his Breakfast Badge, so he can make whatever the Squirrels would like to eat - as it turns out they all like very different things for breakfast!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E12 Bob Bilby When it's Bingo's turn to bring her Kindy's Bob Bilby puppet home and record their weekend in the scrapbook, the family resolve to put down their screens and show him a good time.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S8 E1 Grandpa's Robot Peppa and George go to Granny and Grandpa Pig's house, where Grandpa Pig introduces his robot to them.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: MaeBee
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 Mae, Bee and the Dandelion Wand When Mae blows all but one seed off a dandelion, she accidentally creates a wish filled magic wand. However, her spells spiral out of control as she tries to fix magic with magic!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Big Lizard
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Magnetite A strange find far away from the ship breaks D.O.R.I.S.'s sat nav. Luckily, Big Lizard's on hand to teach Cosima how to find her way around without technology.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E39 The Octonauts And The Enormous Elephant Seal When Peso and the Octonauts aid an enormous Elephant Seal, he overstays his welcome in the Octopod.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Kangaroo Beach
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E4 The Trophy Mystery The cadets are tasked with babysitting toddler penguin Phillipa, but become distracted when a cheeky crab scurries off with a lifeguard trophy.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Super Monsters
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E7 Just Imagine The Super Monsters reimagine Alice in Wonderland with creativity, teamwork, and magical twists.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Spidey and His Amazing Friends
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E33 The Maltese Kitten Team Spidey and Black Cat join forces to stop Doc Ock from destroying the precious Maltese Kitten.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E20 Flower On A Plate Flower must bring a dish representing her family to a school picnic, but how can she choose when she loves both Dad's Austrian and Mum's Cantonese cooking equally? Time to get creative!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E39 Journey to the Centre of the Earth Naughty Daisy and Poppy magic their teacher, Mrs Fotheringill to the centre of the Earth. Granpapa Thistle leads Ben and Holly on a dangerous mission through dinosaurs and volcanoes in order to find the missing teacher.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 The Lucky Charm Pancake rubs a 'lucky icicle' to bring him good luck, but panics when it's rubbed away.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Peppa Pig
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S11 E36 Mummy Pig's Work Trip Today, Mummy Pig has a work trip to promote her new book. In her absence, Peppa spends the day pretending to be Mummy Pig.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: The Octonauts

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Piripenguins

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E27 Painting Seasons With Costa's help and the power of their imaginations, the junior gardeners choose a plant each and paint it across four seasons.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Bluey
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E14 Mum School Bluey plays mum to a brood of bouncy balloons, including an irrepressible floater named Greenie. But she soon discovers that mothering is much harder than she imagined.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E18 Remote Control Game on! Everyone is excitedly getting ready to watch a football match on TV, when an out of control toy plane hits the TV aerial, ruining the picture. Bitzer is sent to fix the problem and asks the Flock for help.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Monkie Kid
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E5 Coming Home When Mei, a member of the Dragon Family, and MK house sit, DBK's minions attempt to infiltrate the house and steal the legendary Dragon Blade.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Monkie Kid
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E6 Noodles Or Death When Pigsy is taken hostage by the Spider Queen, Sandy, MK, Mei, and Mo must take their race boat down into the sewers and free their friends.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: E208 Episode 208 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Night Eyes

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E6 Jake the Dad Jake's a daddy, but being a father and keeping his rainicorn pups from killing themselves or each other is a lot harder than he imagined.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Battlebots
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E6 Most Outrageous Moments For over 20 years, BattleBots has been home to massive explosions, military-grade shrapnel, and destruction and carnage beyond belief. Count down the Most Outrageous Moments in robot combat history.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Merlin
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E11 The Witch's Quickening Merlin sees a shocking new side to Morgana when Mordred returns to Camelot asking for her help.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Young Sheldon
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E1 Half A Wiener Schnitzel and Underwear In A Tree News of the tornado reaches Sheldon and Mary in Germany. Also, with the Cooper house in chaos, Missy steps up.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Pokemon: Ruby and Sapphire
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E36 Me, Myself and Time Ash and Pikachu meet up with an aspiring archaeologist who leads them to an ancient and mystical site.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Dragon Ball Super

Trunks is risking it all to get back to the past to find help. But will he escape the new evil that threatens the future in time to get help?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Miraculous: Tales Of Ladybug And Cat Noir
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E10 Mega Leech When Malediktator comes back, now seconded by a Sentimonster, Ladybug entrusts a committed friend and ally with a Miraculous to help her save Paris.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: We Bare Bears
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S3 E4 Professor Lampwick Chloe's professor is too mean to give her any face time to talk over her poor grade.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Teen Titans Go!
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S6 E8 Bat Scouts To reach the highest rank in the Bat Scouts, Robin teaches the other Titans important vigilante skills.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E20 What A Boy Wonders Robin forms a book club to debut his new autobiography, but the Titans would rather discuss other books.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E30 Stingin' in the Rain When Chef gets locked outside in a storm, the kids mistakenly assume he's a robber and decide to protect the daycare. by any means necessary.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Malory Towers
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E7 The Speech It's Open Day and Darrell and Felicity are excited to see their parents. Darrell is unhappy to learn that Felicity has invited June to join them for their picnic lunch.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Horrible Histories
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E14 Ridiculous Romance In this one-off Horrible Histories: Ridiculous Romance special, we discover what pulled the heartstrings of some of the most famous lovers of days gone by (and the sometimes not-so-lucky objects of their affection).

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Horrible Histories
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E14 Sports Special The multi-award-winning comedy sketch brings fans a special sports-themed episode, packed full of fascinating facts about some of the top sporting moments from the past.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Horrible Histories
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E15 Scary Special Multi-award-winning comedy sketch show Horrible Histories joins the Halloween celebrations with this scary special presented by Death of 'Stupid Death' fame, who presents his very own show crammed full of spooky highlights.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Odd Squad
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E106 The Scientist Oona gets zapped to an alternate dimension.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Disney Jr.'s Ariel
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E17 Daddy Daughter Adventure Day / Rainbow Sea Caves Ariel and Triton spend Daddy Daughter Adventure Day together. Ariel explores Rainbow Sea Caves.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E26 Max Plays at the Library Max learns that Mr. McFeely is the story time reader and a mail carrier. You can be more than one thing!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Maddie + Triggs
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E22 Microwave Maddie + Triggs are intrigued when Mum suggests they use the microwave to cook dinner; can this singing robot microwave really make a healthy meal that's delicious and nutritious?

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E39 Journey to the Centre of the Earth Naughty Daisy and Poppy magic their teacher, Mrs Fotheringill to the centre of the Earth. ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E31 Big Pooba Problems Nubs is eager to prove himself to an adult Pooba.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: PJ Masks
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S4 E19 Munki-gu Gekko tries to train a naughty monkey. and hide this from An Yu.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E28 The Magical Nines Ninety puts on a magic show to help the Numberblobs discover who's in the Nine Times.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E19 Wheel Loader No job is too big for a wheel loader. See how they work with Fantus!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E30 Babysitting Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out so Granny and Grandpa Pig are baby-sitting. Peppa and George are put to bed but are too excited to sleep. Everyone has such fun that they exhaust themselves.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E17 Wake Up Lachy! Sing along to 'Rock-a-Bye Your Bear' but look! Lachy has fallen asleep. The Wiggles try to wake him up, and they need your help! Next, come and see what Buddy is getting up to at the beach.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Shaun the Sheep
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S5 E11 Happy Farmers' Day Bitzer treats the farmer to a restaurant style dining experience, offering a delicious pie as the main course.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E14 Washed Away Spidey and Ms. Marvel go down into the sewer tunnels to save TRACE-E, but they discover the Green Goblin is down there!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Supertato
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E31 Broccoli Flies Again Evil Pea asks for flying lessons when Broccoli flies her paper plane into her freezer. Evil Pea doesn't let Broccoli know that she intends to fly high to take over Tato Tower.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Superkitties
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S2 E7 Seed Stealer / Dastardly Dumpster The SuperKitties teach Zsa-Zsa that if she takes care of planted seeds, they'll grow into fruits and veggies for everyone to enjoy. Lab Rat and Otto drop trash on Kittydale.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 The Tooth Fairy Ben and Holly are excited when they learn that Nanny Plum is a Tooth Fairy at night, and go along with her to pick up a little girl's tooth. But the little girl is not so little - she's a human and much bigger than them!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E26 Rainbow Stones When Flower's fun weekend plans are washed out by rain, Flower leads her friends on a playful indoor quest to gather five rainbow stones, inspired by a tale from Por Por, to stop the rain.

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.title: Flower & Flour
ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S1 E27 Por Por Day Flower can't wait for Por Por Day, expecting a lazy day of treats, but she's surprised when her grandmother reveals she has a packed schedule planned!

ABCKids_ABCTV PlusBrisbane.au.description: S7 E49 Little Cars Peppa and her friends visit the Little Cars play centre where Miss Rabbit is in charge.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Do Not Watch This Show
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E4 Space Creature When Wizz finds a friendly Space Creature on his couch, he has no choice but to try and help her get back to her home before the Fun Suckers find her and put her in space prison.

ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Get Gran Home Power up this lost granny by moving left and right, and running on the spot - that way you'll help this little old lady dodge debris on the road and make her way home. But hurry up, she hasn't got all day!

ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E24 The Printing Crew Meet the Printing Crew - Yellow, Cyan, and Magenta. Learn how together they can mix lots of colours in the Printing Zone.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Numberblocks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S6 E24 Fractions are a Piece of Cake One has been invited to the Fraction Friends party and first meets One Whole. How will the friends share the party food? Luckily they have a song that helps them work it all out!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Super Why's Comic Book Adventures ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E29 Talent Trouble! Alpha Pig's transforming shoes go haywire and send him tapdancing into danger!

ABCMESydney.au.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S2 E8 Vacuum Cleaner Maddie visits an appliance testing centre to find out how a vacuum cleaner works.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Gardening Australia Junior
ABCMESydney.au.description: S3 E24 Native Garden School With some help from students, Clarence and Savannah revive a playground garden bed with local native plants.

ABCMESydney.au.title: The Ancient World Greece
ABCMESydney.au.description: E6 Colonisation The ancient Greeks were adventurers, always looking towards new lands and fresh challenges. During the Archaic and Hellenistic periods, the ancient Greeks formed new colonies from Spain to Sri Lanka.

ABCMESydney.au.description: E33 Episode 33 BTN is a high-energy, fun way for Upper Primary and Secondary students to learn about current issues and events in their world. Each program is built around major news stories of the week.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Stories of Modern Australia ᴺᵉʷ
ABCMESydney.au.description: S1 E4 Immigration Post-WWII Discover the stories of migrants and refugees who came to Australia after World War II, and how their contributions helped to build Australia of today.

ABCMESydney.au.title: BtN Newsbreak
ABCMESydney.au.description: E206 Episode 206 Find out what's going on in the world with a news bulletin designed for children, featuring stories that are relevant and easy to understand.

ABCMESydney.au.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E7 Floating Home And A Magical Vista A couple creates an ambitious floating home; two siblings build their own mobile homes away from home; George and Will conjure up a magical 30-mile vista in a wall just 20 cm thick.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Spooks
ABCMESydney.au.description: S4 E9 Harry is suspended after he has a suspected terrorist in CIA custody released. His decision proves fatal for an MI5 surveillance team.

ABCMESydney.au.title: Fresh Off the Boat

ABCMESydney.au.title: QI

ABCMESydney.au.title: Would I Lie To You?
ABCMESydney.au.description: S10 E9 The Unseen Bits Rob Brydon, Lee Mack and David Mitchell return for a special episode of previously unseen material, looking back at the best moments, with celebrity guests including Kevin Bishop, Warwick Davis and Romesh Ranganathan. (Final).

ABCMESydney.au.title: Mythbusters

BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E2 Battlefield: Part 2 The Doctor and Ace explore King Arthur’s spaceship deep under Lake Vortigern, while Brigadier Lethbridge-Stewart arrives in Carbury where he encounters Morgaine.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E3 Battlefield: Part 3 Furious at her inability to find and engage Arthur in battle, Morgaine threatens to unleash the Destroyer upon the planet unless the Doctor gives her what she wants.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E4 Battlefield: Part 4 The Brigadier slays the Destroyer while Morgaine takes control of UNIT's nuclear warhead and prepares to start a countdown that will destroy Earth forever.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E5 Ghost Light: Part 1 The Doctor and Ace explore Victorian house Gabriel Chase and realise it hides just as many dark secrets in its Drawing Room as it does in the dark cellar.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E6 Ghost Light: Part 2 The Doctor and Scotland Yard’s finest, Inspector Mackenzie, attempt to question Josiah Smith while both Light and Control emerge from their respective slumbers.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E7 Ghost Light: Part 3 Only Redvers, still searching for the elusve Saxe-Coburg, seems to be able to withstand Light and communicate with Control and Ace realises her past actions need to be dealt with.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E8 The Curse of Fenric: Part 1 As Russian forces approach the English coastline, an ancient evil stirs beneath the surface of the water. For Ace and the Doctor, a deadly game of revenge has begun.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E9 The Curse of Fenric: Part 2 The Viking runes in the crypt contain a secret to Ace’s past, while Millington and Judson’s Ultima machine offers to break the chains of the Wolves of Fenric.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E10 The Curse of Fenric: Part 3 The Haemovores attack St Jude’s church and the insane Millington willingly sacrifices his men. Doctor Judson dies, only to be reborn as the true evil, Fenric himself.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E11 The Curse of Fenric: Part 4 The Ancient Haemovore stands upon the Earth once again, determined to change the future by erasing the past and Ace finally feels love for her mother.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E12 Survival: Part 1 Trying to work out why people have been disappearing from Perivale, Ace is cornered by a Cheetah-Person on a horse called Kara, who transports her to a far-off planet.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E13 Survival: Part 2 The Doctor and a number of people from Perivale follow Ace to the Cheetah-People’s world, where the Master lies in wait. He cannot leave without the Doctor's assistance.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S26 E14 Survival: Part 3 As the alien world dies around them, the Doctor and the Master fight like animals before escaping to Earth, where their war ends. And somewhere else, the tea is getting cold.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E5 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 1 UNIT are summoned to Wenley Moor research station which is experiencing mysterious power losses. In the nearby caves, one of the staff has been killed and another sent insane.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E6 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 2 Investigating the caves, the Doctor is attacked by a dinosaur-like creature. Dr Quinn is hiding a secret that could endanger the lives of everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E7 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 3 The creature from the caves, wounded and dangerous, is on the loose on Wenley Moor. Dr Quinn attempts to recover it and is unwilling to listen to the Doctor’s warnings.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E8 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 4 Fearful of a war breaking out between the Silurians and mankind, the Doctor attempts to make peace between the races. But there are those on both sides unwilling to listen.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E9 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 5 When the Silurian leader is killed, all hopes of peace are lost. The Silurian’s infect Major Baker with a virus deadly to humans and release him to spread the infection.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E10 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 6 As the Silurian plague quickly spreads, the Doctor desperately searches for a cure. But the Silurians are aware of the Doctor’s efforts and intend to stop him.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E11 Doctor Who and the Silurians: Episode 7 With the antidote to the plague found, the Silurians retaliate and take over the research centre. They now intend to destroy the Van Allen Belt, resulting in death for all mankind.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E12 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 1 Contact has been lost with Mars Probe 7. When contact is also lost with the recovery ship, UNIT is called in and the Doctor learns that someone is sending messages to the vessel.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E13 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 2 Recovery 7 has returned to Earth but the UNIT convoy transporting the capsule is ambushed. The Doctor is able to relocate the capsule, but is he too late?

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E14 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 3 The recovery capsule is empty with the astronauts seemingly kidnapped. But Liz notices that the radiation count is high and the Doctor deduces that the occupants were not human.

BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E15 The Ambassadors of Death: Episode 4 Liz has been captured by Reegan who is holding the three aliens captive. The Doctor suspects Quinlan’s part in the conspiracy, but Quinlan is killed before he can reveal the truth.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S7 E20 Inferno: Episode 2 The green slime oozing from the drill head is transforming men into monsters. Stahlman refuses to listen to the warnings and resorts to sabotage so that his project may continue.

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. fxm.us.title: Ad Astra
fxm.us.description: Thirty years ago, Clifford McBride led a voyage into deep space, but the ship and crew were never heard from again. Now his son -- a fearless astronaut -- must embark on a daring mission to Neptune to uncover the truth about his missing father and a mysterious power surge that threatens the stability of the universe. fxm.us.title: The Aftermath
fxm.us.description: In 1946 Rachael Morgan arrives in the ruins of Hamburg to be reunited with her husband, Lewis, who is a British colonel charged with rebuilding the shattered city. As they set off for their new home, Rachael is stunned to discover that Lewis has made an unexpected decision: They will be sharing the grand house with its previous owners, a German widower and his troubled daughter. In this charged atmosphere, enmity and grief give way to passion and betrayal. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2019

fxm.us.title: 100 Rifles
fxm.us.description: When half-breed Indian Yaqui Joe (Burt Reynolds) robs an Arizona bank, he is pursued by dogged lawman Lyedecker (Jim Brown). Fleeing to Mexico, Joe is imprisoned by General Verdugo (Fernando Lamas), who is waging a war against the Yaqui Indians. When Lyedecker attempts to intervene, he is thrown into prison as well. Working together, the two escape and take refuge in the hills, where Lyedecker meets beautiful Yaqui freedom fighter Sarita (Raquel Welch) and begins to question his allegiances. (Western) - 1969

fxm.us.title: The Earth Dies Screaming
fxm.us.description: An astronaut (Willard Parker) returns from a test flight to find England overtaken by alien-controlled robots which turn corpses into zombies. (Science fiction) - 1964

fxm.us.title: Squad Car
fxm.us.description: An accused man (Don Marlowe) helps a policeman (Paul Bryar) investigate an airplane mechanic's death and a counterfeit racket. (Crime drama) - 1960

fxm.us.title: Berlin Correspondent
fxm.us.description: In 1941 Berlin, the Gestapo's efforts to uncover the source of vital information broadcast by American correspondent Bill Roberts remain elusive. The Gestapo colonel in charge of the investigation presses his fiancée, Karen Hauen, to help and, with reluctance, she agrees. After befriending Bill, Karen discovers how he receives the information, but when she also learns who provides it, she is exposed for the first time to the brutal tactics of her government. (Thriller) - 1942

fxm.us.title: Where the Sidewalk Ends
fxm.us.description: Ashamed that his father lived a life of crime, hard-boiled New York City cop Mark Dixon has a reputation for being too tough on criminals. So when Dixon unintentionally kills a murder suspect during a routine questioning, he hides the fact from the department and tries to pin the killing on his nemesis, notorious gangster Scalise. The snag in the cop's plan comes when his boss wrongly accuses the father of Dixon's love interest, Morgan, of the murder. (Crime drama) - 1950

fxm.us.title: Black Widow
fxm.us.description: At a party, Broadway producer Peter Denver (Van Heflin) meets Nancy Ordway (Peggy Ann Garner), a young writer struggling to make it in New York City. Taking pity on her, Denver offers Nancy his apartment as a place to write while his wife, Iris (Gene Tierney), is away. Shortly after, Nancy is found dead in his bathroom, apparently murdered, and Denver is, of course, the main suspect. As rumors swirl about his involvement with Nancy, Denver decides to search for her killer himself. (Mystery) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Neptune Factor
fxm.us.description: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival. (Science fiction) - 1973

fxm.us.title: Eyewitness
fxm.us.description: New York City custodian Daryll Deever (William Hurt) is a big fan of local news reporter Tony Sokolow (Sigourney Weaver), so he is intrigued when she shows up to cover a story at his workplace. There's been a murder in the office building, and Tony suspects that Daryll may have insight into the crime, a notion that he furthers to stay close to her. However, when those behind the killing begin to think that Daryll really knows something, they target both him and Tony to keep their secrets hidden. (Thriller) - 1981

fxm.us.title: The Aftermath
fxm.us.description: In 1946 Rachael Morgan arrives in the ruins of Hamburg to be reunited with her husband, Lewis, who is a British colonel charged with rebuilding the shattered city.
