In this charged atmosphere, enmity and grief give way to passion and betrayal. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2019

fxm.us.title: The Last Duel
fxm.us.description: Jean de Carrouges is a respected knight known for his bravery and skill on the battlefield. Jacques Le Gris is a squire whose intelligence and eloquence makes him one of the most admired nobles in court. When Le Gris viciously assaults Carrouges' wife, she steps forward to accuse her attacker, an act of bravery and defiance that puts her life in jeopardy. The ensuing trial by combat, a grueling duel to the death, places the fate of all three in God's hands. (Historical drama) - 2021

fxm.us.title: The Banshees of Inisherin
fxm.us.description: On a remote island off the coast of Ireland, Pádraic is devastated when his buddy Colm suddenly puts an end to their lifelong friendship. With help from his sister and a troubled young islander, Pádraic sets out to repair the damaged relationship by any means necessary. However, as Colm's resolve only strengthens, he soon delivers an ultimatum that leads to shocking consequences. (Dark comedy) - 2022

fxm.us.title: Freud's Last Session
fxm.us.description: On the eve of World War II, Sigmund Freud and C.S. Lewis gather to discuss the existence of God and the future of mankind. (Drama) - 2023

fxm.us.title: Dirty Mary, Crazy Larry
fxm.us.description: Down on their luck and out of cash, high-speed racer Larry (Peter Fonda) and his repairman (Adam Roarke) plan to hold up a supermarket that's fat with a fresh payroll. Larry hopes to score enough to buy his ideal car, and then join the professional league. At the last minute, their heist is complicated by the addition of Larry's on-off girlfriend (Susan George), who's all jazzed up for the burglary. Larry's racing skills will be pushed to the limit in this chase-packed action thriller. (Action) - 1974

fxm.us.title: Surf Party

fxm.us.title: How to Marry a Millionaire
fxm.us.description: Schatze Page, Loco Dempsey and Pola Debevoise (Lauren Bacall, Betty Grable, Marilyn Monroe) are three women on a mission: They all want to marry a millionaire. To accomplish this task, they move into a fancy New York City apartment and begin courting the city's elite. They have no problem meeting rich men, but unfortunately most of them turn out to be creeps or cons. Eventually they must decide: Is a life of luxury more important to them than finding true love? (Comedy) - 1953

fxm.us.title: The Seven Year Itch
fxm.us.description: In the midst of a summer heat wave, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) ships his wife, Helen (Evelyn Keyes), and their son off to Maine for vacation. Left alone to work back in Manhattan, Richard encounters a gorgeous blonde model (Marilyn Monroe) who has moved into the apartment upstairs, and becomes immediately infatuated. While pondering infidelity, Richard dreams of his beautiful new neighbor -- but will his fantasies about her become a reality? (Comedy) - 1955

5starmax.us.title: Mississippi Masala
5starmax.us.description: After Mina's Indian family is ousted from their home in Uganda by dictator Idi Amin, they relocate to Mississippi to start a new life. Mina falls for Demetrius, a young carpet cleaner, despite the protestations of their families over their racial difference. The families and their surrounding communities begin to feud, putting even more pressure on the couple's romance. Having to choose between family and love, Mina and Demetrius run away together. (Comedy drama) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: The Curse of Michael Myers
5starmax.us.description: This installment marks the return of the seemingly indestructible masked murderer Michael Myers (George P. Wilbur), who is targeting Tommy Doyle (Paul Stephen Rudd), a young man tied into the legacy of the killer and his connections with the Strode family. As the supernatural elements of Michael's macabre abilities are explored, his longtime adversary, Dr. Sam Loomis (Donald Pleasence), is also back in yet another attempt to stop the psychopath's brutal rampages. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
5starmax.us.description: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former babysitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 1998

5starmax.us.title: Halloween: Resurrection
5starmax.us.description: He's back for more... When a group of teens wins a contest to spend a night in Michael Myers' childhood home to be broadcast live on the Internet, they believe they are in for a little fun and some free publicity. But things go frightfully wrong and the game turns into a struggle to make it out of the house alive. (Holiday, Horror, Thriller) - 2002

5starmax.us.title: A Clockwork Orange
5starmax.us.description: In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims. (Dark comedy) - 1971

5starmax.us.title: Night on Earth
5starmax.us.description: This film presents five stories, each involving a cab ride and set in a different city around the world. In Los Angeles, no-nonsense taxi driver Corky (Winona Ryder) gets an engaging customer in the form of a Hollywood casting agent (Gena Rowlands), while a Parisian cabbie (Isaach de Bankolé) must contend with some rowdy African diplomats. Among the other tales, a standout is the Italian taxi ride that finds quirky driver Gino (Roberto Benigni) making a lively confession to an ailing priest. (Comedy drama, Drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Twin Peaks: Fire Walk With Me
5starmax.us.description: In the folksy town of Deerfield, Wash., FBI Agent Desmond (Chris Isaak) inexplicably disappears while hunting for the man who murdered a teen girl. The killer is never apprehended, and, after experiencing dark visions and supernatural encounters, Agent Dale Cooper (Kyle MacLachlan) chillingly predicts that the culprit will claim another life. Meanwhile, in the similarly cozy town of Twin Peaks, hedonistic beauty Laura Palmer (Sheryl Lee) hangs with lowlifes and seems destined for a grisly fate. (Crime drama) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Open Water
5starmax.us.description: Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller. (Thriller, Adventure, Drama, Horror) - 2003

5starmax.us.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
5starmax.us.description: Sue Ellen Crandell is a teenager eagerly awaiting her mother's summer-long absence. While the babysitter looks after her rambunctious younger siblings, Sue Ellen can party and have fun. But then the babysitter abruptly dies, leaving the Crandells short on cash. Sue Ellen finds a sweet job in fashion by lying about her age and experience on her résumé. But, while her siblings run wild, she discovers the downside of adulthood. (Comedy) - 1991

5starmax.us.title: Hoot
5starmax.us.description: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds. (Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2006

aspire.us.title: City Eats: Charleston - My Three Sons
aspire.us.description: My Three Sons feels like stepping into a family reunion, the kind where everyone is welcome and every dish tastes like a memory; Cake Daddy and Cake Baby bring the fun, but it's the seafood rice, crab soup, and signature red velvet cake that keep folks coming back. Charleston's warmth, resilience, and tradition live here, in a kitchen that cooks with love and legacy; it's soul food the way it was meant to be: personal, comforting, unforgettable. (Cooking) - 2026-07-09

aspire.us.title: City Eats: Charleston - 39 Rue de Jean
aspire.us.description: Chef Letha McClary brings the spirit of the Lowcountry into a French brasserie that feels lifted straight from a Parisian side street; her coq au vin, chicken francaise, and deeply rooted memories of her grandmother's red rice turn classic dishes into shared stories; 39 Rue de Jean becomes a meeting place for cultures, where French finesse and Southern soul dance on the same plate; it's a reminder that honoring where you come from can create something beautifully new. (Cooking) - 2026-07-16

aspire.us.title: City Eats: Charleston - Ma'am Saab
aspire.us.description: Charleston's first Pakistani restaurant arrives with color, spice, and centuries of culinary tradition; owner Raheel Gauba transports diners through the Mughal era with deeply aromatic dishes like butter chicken and shrimp biryani, each one crafted with reverence and joy; Ma'am Saab is more than a restaurant; it's an invitation into a vibrant culture that's been waiting to be shared; Charleston embraces it fully, proving once again that flavor has no borders. (Cooking) - 2026-07-23

aspire.us.title: City Eats: Charleston - King BBQ
aspire.us.description: King BBQ takes everything you think you know about barbecue and flips it on its head; Chef Shuai Wang, Pitmaster Brandon Olson, and Corrie Wang blend Chinatown flavors with Southern smoke, creating dishes like crispy pork belly, five spice chicken, and duck breast wrapped in fluffy bao; this isn't fusion, it's a fearless, flavorful collision of craft and culture; in Charleston, where reinvention thrives, King BBQ proves that tradition can evolve without losing its soul. (Cooking) - 2026-07-30

bbcfood.us.title: Rick Stein From Venice to Istanbul

bbcfood.us.title: Raymond Blanc's Kitchen Secrets

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: Card Sharks
buzzr.us.description: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800. (Game show) - 1978-04-24

cartoonnetwork.us.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
cartoonnetwork.us.description: No, this animated series is not about anthropomorphic chewing gum, it's about a young cat named Gumball Watterson. Gumball has a penchant for getting into trouble, often resulting from schemes he comes up with, but he never seems to learn his lesson. Gumball's best friend is a fish named Darwin, who used to be the family pet until he grew legs and became part of the family. Gumball resents his younger sister, Anais, because she is the smartest member of the family. Gumball's mother is the breadwinner in the family, working long hours at the rainbow factory, and his father stays at home watching TV and playing video games. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure, Fantasy) - 2011-05-03

cinevault.us.title: That's My Boy
cinevault.us.description: While still a teen himself, Donny (Adam Sandler) fathered a son, Todd (Andy Samberg), and raised him as a single parent. On Todd's 18th birthday, Donny cut the youth loose. After years of estrangement, the older man shows up unexpectedly on the eve of his son's wedding day, sending the young man's life into a tailspin. Donny wants desperately to reconnect with Todd, but he must now deal with the repercussions of the bad parenting he exhibited in the past. (Comedy, Movie) - 2012-06-15

cinevault.us.title: Blue Streak
cinevault.us.description: When a heist goes wrong, thief Miles hides a diamond at a construction site before he's arrested. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 1999-09-17

cinevault.us.title: Last Action Hero
cinevault.us.description: Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him. (Action, Comedy, Movie) - 1993-06-18

cinevault.us.title: Jack and Jill
cinevault.us.description: Thanksgiving is usually a happy time, but ad executive Jack (Adam Sandler) dreads the holiday because his twin sister, Jill (also Sandler), makes her annual visit. When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer. (Comedy, Movie) - 2011-11-11

cinevault.us.title: Life Without Dick
cinevault.us.description: After consulting a fortuneteller, painter Colleen (Sarah Jessica Parker) begins to suspect that her private-eye boyfriend, Dick (Johnny Knoxville), is cheating. When she comes home and finds him packing to leave her, Colleen accidentally kills him. Nervous Irish Mafia hit man Daniel (Harry Connick Jr.), who's been gunning for Dick, arrives shortly afterward and admits he has never successfully completed a job. Daniel proposes to take credit for the murder, and the odd couple fall in love. (Movie, Romantic comedy) - 2001

cinevault.us.title: Jury Duty
cinevault.us.description: An unemployed male stripper and certifiable slacker, Tommy Collins (Pauly Shore) ends up homeless when his mom throws him out of their trailer. Desperate for a place to stay, Collins figures that landing a spot on a jury should get him a roof over his head, food in his belly and a few bucks in his pocket. Shockingly, his plan works -- and he will do anything to delay the trial's verdict so he can keep living large and make his moves on knockout juror Monica (Tia Carrere). (Comedy, Movie) - 1995-10-24

cinevault.us.title: Cops and Robbersons
cinevault.us.description: Tough-guy police officer Jake Stone and his less seasoned partner, Tony Moore, are intent on taking down Osborn, a ruthless criminal. However, since Osborn is holed up in the suburbs, Jake and Tony must hold their stakeout in a neighboring house, home to the Robbersons. The well-meaning family, including patriarch Norman, tries to assist the cops in their duties, but it proves to be unwanted help. (Comedy, Movie) - 1994-04-15

cinevault.us.title: Hero
cinevault.us.description: Serial swindler Bernie Laplante (Dustin Hoffman) makes the first selfless gesture of his life when he helps save injured passengers from a roadside plane crash and then vanishes into the night. Hoping to find the hero who pulled her out of the wreck, reporter Gale Gayley (Geena Davis) announces a $1 million prize for stepping forward. But when handsome vagrant John Bubber (Andy Garcia) takes credit, Bernie struggles to expose him amid a media circus and countless adoring fans. (Comedy drama, Movie) - 1992-10-02

circlecountry.us.title: The Undefeated

After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them. (Western) - 1969

classica.us.title: Schumann: Humoreske, Op. 20

classica.us.title: Donizetti: Don Pasquale
classica.us.description: Aus dem Teatro Filarmonico di Verona: "Don Pasquale" von Gaetano Donizetti (1797-1848). Musikalische Leitung: Omer Meir Wellber - Inszenierung: Antonio Albanese. Mit Simone Alaimo (Don Pasquale), Mario Cassi (Malatesta), Irina Lungu (Norina), Francesco Demuro (Ernesto). Zum großen Missfallen seines Onkels Don Pasquale hat Ernesto sich in die junge Witwe Norina verliebt. Auf Doktor Malatestas Rat gibt Norina sich als dessen Schwester Sofronia aus und umwirbt Don Pasquale. (Special, Opera, Comedy, Music) - 2014-01-15

classica.us.title: In der Probe: - Esa-Pekka Salonen
classica.us.description: Esa-Pekka Salonen probt mit dem Los Angeles Philharmoniker Claude Debussys Orchesterwerk "La mer". Probeaufnahmen wie diese liefern einen spannenden Einblick in Salonens akribische Arbeit und sein Verhältnis zu den Musikern und der Musik. (Music) - 2008-04-16

classica.us.title: Verdi, Messa da Requiem
classica.us.description: Giuseppe Verdi (1813-1901): "Messa da Requiem". Anja Harteros (Sopran), Elīna Garanča (Mezzosopran), Jonas Kaufmann (Tenor), René Pape (Bass), Chor und Orchester des Teatro alla Scala; Leitung: Daniel Barenboim. Verdis "Requiem" zählt neben Ludwig van Beethovens "Missa solemnis" und Johannes Brahms' "Deutschem Requiem" zu den großen Meisterwerken geistlicher Musik des 19. Jahrhunderts. outlaw.us.title: The Hanging Tree
outlaw.us.description: Joseph "Doc" Frail (Gary Cooper) is a doctor with a past he's trying to outrun. While in Montana, he comes across a mining camp with a hanging tree and rescues a man named Rune (Ben Piazza) from the noose. With Rune as his servant, Frail decides to settle down, and he takes over as town doctor. He meets Elizabeth (Maria Schell), who is suffering from shock, and the two soon fall in love. But when Elizabeth is attacked, Frail's attempt to help her land them both in trouble. (Western) - 1959

outlaw.us.title: Mail Order Bride
outlaw.us.description: In late-19th-century Montana, Will Lane (Buddy Ebsen) is sent to look after unruly Lee (Keir Dullea), the son of a deceased pal. Lane hopes to find Lee a bride who'll tame him, so he selects a mail-order wife, Annie (Lois Nettleton). All goes according to plan, until carefree bachelor Lee makes a deal with Annie: he'll support her financially if she leaves him after the wedding. Annie agrees, but when Lee truly falls for his bride-to-be, he must choose between his lawless ways and settling down. (Western) - 1964

outlaw.us.title: 3 Godfathers
outlaw.us.description: Thieves and rustlers Robert Hightower (John Wayne), Pete Fuerte (Pedro Armendáriz) and the Abilene Kid (Harry Carey Jr.) rob a bank in a small Arizona town. Pursued across the desert by the indefatigable Sheriff Buck Sweet (Ward Bond), the trio lose their horses, suffer injuries, and come across a stranded woman (Mildred Natwick) who is dying while giving birth. Promising to carry the woman's newborn to safety, the repentant criminals struggle to reach the village of New Jerusalem. (Western) - 1948

outlaw.us.title: The Charge at Feather River
outlaw.us.description: A frontier scout (Guy Madison) leads prisoners on a death mission to save a railroad and rescue two women. (Western) - 1953

outlaw.us.title: The Last Hunt
outlaw.us.description: Sandy McKenzie has a long history of hunting buffalo, but now that the herds have been so thinned out, he's come to regret it. Nevertheless, he partners up with Charlie Gilson for one last hunt that proves to be the worst of them all. Charlie is a twisted, insensate killer of both buffalo and Indians, and when he kidnaps and abuses a young Indian girl, Sandy is pushed to the breaking point. (Western) - 1956

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E12 Communal Gathering Space H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E14 Modern Woodshop Newlyweds Cheryl and Gavin love their new home, but Cheryl doesn't love the sound of Gavin's woodworking in the garage. Brian and Sarah help by building a dedicated wood shop and some chic new living space in their urban backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E05 Wellness Wonderland Breanna & Nick's life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen'd out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E02 Creative Shipping Container Kirsten works from the home office, while Joel is a sales representative with a make-shift workspace in their bedroom. To help this couple, Brian and Sarah look to the backyard for space to retrofit an old shipping container into an office.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E06 His and Hers Hideaway Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E02 Twins Clubhouse Sham, Ruban and their twin boys aren't using their big, boring backyard. To help this family embrace the great outdoors, Brian and Sarah build a vacation style getaway, with a beach volleyball court and a kid's clubhouse.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E03 Rustic Barn Rehab Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E02 Family of Five Funhouse Love is large, but space is tight for Lara & Mike and their 5 children. Brian and Sarah free up space by building an activity-packed tree house and recreation court for the children, with grilling, dining and lounging areas for the whole family.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E04 Stained Glass Studio Couple Farzana & Reyan have maxed out all living space in their city-sized bungalow, leaving no room for Reyan's at-home stained-glass business or Farzana's writing. Brian and Sarah build Reyan a spacious studio and construct an inspiring deck area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E07 Plunge Pool Paradise Aarati & Dave both work from home, forcing their living room to be a triple duty working/living/children's play area. Brian and Sarah create a flexible structure, install a sleek and sophisticated plunge pool, and create an outdoor fireplace lounge.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E08 Pooch Party Pavillion Carly & Nate's social media star dog, Dean the Basset Hound, has a lot of four-legged friends visiting, leaving the home feeling cramped. Brian and Sarah make a bar/lounge for pet and owner gatherings, along with a stylish outdoor entertainment area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E04 Country Supper Club & Coop Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark's friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E01 Inspiring Cake Studio Tina and her husband Patrick have a home that is overrun with both baking supplies and soccer equipment. To extend this family's living space, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into one part cake decorating studio and one part soccer field.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E07 Outdoor Amphitheater Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theater in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E05 Farm to Table Andrea and David are foodies, but hosting in their "builder basic" yard is no fun. Brian and Sarah make their farm-to-table dreams come true, with a veggie garden, dining room, BBQ zone, and a play space for their 2 kids.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E04 Treehouse Village Debbie, Kevin, and their three children are a newly-blended family. To bring this new family together, Brian and Sarah build an irresistible treehouse village in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E04 Tropical Family Resort Tammy and Sam are so busy, their backyard has fallen into disrepair and their 2 kids never use it. Brian and Sarah bring this yard back to life, and then some, with a new dining and lounge area and a fully functional pool house.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E06 Neighborhood Party House Nicole and Charles have 3 kids, and their neighborhood parties are getting too big for their front porch. So Brian and Sarah add more entertaining space in the backyard, plus a 4-season garage conversion with a nautical theme.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E08 D.J.'s Den Cool parents, Michelle and Adrian, are passionate about music and events. Brian and Sarah tune into their needs and amp up their boring backyard with a DJ den, a creative arts-and-crafts wall, and hang-out zones for family jam sessions.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E05 Sports Bar Craig and Claudia share their new space with Craig's brother, Craig's parents - and their two massive dogs. To give these new homeowners a place of their own, Brian and Sarah build a sports bar and entertainment hangout in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E03 Kids Clubhouse Ali and Hana have two very talented young children - and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids' music and arts hangout.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S01 E08 Cottage in the City Steve and Tanya are Realtors who just bought their forever home a few doors down from Tanya's parents. To complete their dream home, Brian and Sarah build a dream cottage retreat in their backyard.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E08 Craft Studio Jenn and Josh don't have enough space in their semi-detached home to enjoy their hobbies. Brian and Sarah build a stylish lounge space and convert the existing garage into a multipurpose space for crafting and playing guitar.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E09 Outdoor Kitchen Marlow, Phil, their 3 small kids, and Phil's parents all live in one crowded house. Brian and Sarah transform their yard into a spectacular space for cooking, entertaining and playing.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S02 E13 Hillside Playhouse Matt, Mary and their 2 kids don't use their backyard because the neighboring ravine has taken over. Brian and Sarah face environmental challenges to create a beautiful, entertaining and play space for the whole family to enjoy.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E01 A Space For Dancing and Hanging Susan's energetic son, Harrison, has no space to dance at home without getting under his mom's feet. Brian and Sarah build a hang-out / dance space for Harrison and create a California-inspired pool and lounge area for Susan.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E03 Cozy Leather Cabin Workshop Brian and Sarah create a backyard for Pam & Kevin that matches their lush forest surrounding complete with a double wrap around deck and a hot tub. The team also build a workshop for Kevin to perfect his craft of leather tooling.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E06 Life-Sized Sister Playhouse Sandra & David's eldest daughter, Harlow, was born with vision challenges and their youngest daughter, Delilah, is just learning to walk. Brian and Sarah build a colorful playland for both children, while also building a decked out BBQ & dining area.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S03 E11 Sports & Social Zone France & Marc's home is being outgrown by their sport-obsessed sons and provides no inspiring space for France to work from home. Brian and Sarah convert a rundown garage into a spot where France can work and carved out safe sports areas.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E03 Parisian Escape Paris lovers, Louise and Rick, want to share their European enthusiasm with their two daughters without racking up the mileage. Brian and Sarah build them a French-inspired urban escape. It's Paris in their backyard! C'est magnifique!

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E05 Gentleman's Gym Mom and son duo, Paul and Catharine, are overwhelmed by Paul's multi-level backyard. Paul also finds his current indoor fitness regime frustrating. Brian and Sarah muscle up to the challenge by building a gym in his backyard, alongside a hot tub.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds
tastemadehome.us.description: S04 E06 Creative Lounge Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

tastemadehome.us.title: Backyard Builds

truehistory.us.title: Lost Worlds of South America - Chavín and the Rise of Religious Authority

(World history) - 2012-12-18

truehistory.us.title: Lost Worlds of South America - The Nazca Lines and Underground Channels

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Macedonian Empire - Greece in the Age of Hegemonies
truehistory.us.description: The story of Alexander starts centuries before his birth, in the Greek city-states throughout the Aegean; the conflicts and political crises that shape the Greek world in the generations before Alexander; his father Philip's conquest of the region. (Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-05-07

truehistory.us.title: Alexander the Great and the Macedonian Empire - Achaemenid Persia

(Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-05-07

(Educational, Ancient history, History) - 2010-05-07

waypointtv.us.title: Blair Wiggins Outdoors : Blair Wiggins Outdoors - Marco Island Line-Siders
waypointtv.us.description: Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.

waypointtv.us.title: The WoodHaven Way
waypointtv.us.description: The WoodHaven Way - Passing Down The Tradition Hunting isn't about the size of the buck, it's about something much bigger; Jeff Lindsey of The Lindsey Way gets to experience one of the most special moments a father and hunter can ask for, introducing his kids to the outdoors.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound - Alabama Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting; he makes dishes with his former "Master Chef" contestant, Alex.

waypointtv.us.title: 200 : Take-Em Outfitters
waypointtv.us.description: Clay and Crystal Charlton of Take-Em Outfitters are after everything big in Alberta! Giant Lake Trout, Monster Black Bear and Big Muleys!

waypointtv.us.title: HuntStand Presents : Second Chance -- Hunting the November Rut in Ohio
waypointtv.us.description: Explore the sacred experiences, emotions and rewards that come from pursuing wild game in wild places.

waypointtv.us.title: 200 : Hunt for a Kansas giant with Chris Schmidt
waypointtv.us.description: Chris Schmidt hunts for his largest whitetail to date during late season in Kansas!

waypointtv.us.title: The Bearded Buck : Don't Fear The Reaper
waypointtv.us.description: Jerry and Austin are joined by Kirk Shebrine and his close friend Scott as they head back to the Cornhusker state to hunt turkeys. They've called in a ton of turkeys over the years but this time they're using a reaping decoy.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Bow Camp at the Dirty Bird
waypointtv.us.description: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

waypointtv.us.title: The Raven Project : Turkey Camp at the Dirty Bird
waypointtv.us.description: The story of a true old school deer camp meeting new world management practices to take a raw piece of hunting land and develop it into whitetail Mecca.

waypointtv.us.title: Just Shot: Realtree Road Trips : Georgia Cover Buck
waypointtv.us.description: Tyler Jordan is back on home turf going after a familiar target - a buck he and the team chased all last season they call the cover buck. With trail cam pics and history on their side.

waypointtv.us.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation : Better Than We Found It
waypointtv.us.description: Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's, addresses the care of natural resources for future generations; Ziehmer asserts it is the responsibility of citizens to leave resources in better condition for the future.

waypointtv.us.title: Winchester Life : Precision Rifle Perfected
waypointtv.us.description: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they'll put Winchester's new Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test.

waypointtv.us.title: Deer and Deer Hunting : Mock Scrape Magic
waypointtv.us.description: Mark Kayser reveals the secrets to building and positioning mock scrapes to outsmart mature bucks and orchestrate the ultimate whitetail setup.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : The Journey Within - Orange Free State of South Africa: Mouflon and Feral Goat
waypointtv.us.description: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he moves into the historic Orange Free State. After incredible hunts in the Eastern Cape and Northern Cape, Mark is shifting his focus to two unique and challenging species: Mouflon and Feral Goat.

waypointtv.us.title: The Journey Within : Mountain Nyala and Bohor Reedbuck - Ethiopia
waypointtv.us.description: A Bird Hunter's Diary is Mark Peterson's quest to hunt and harvest the 43 different species of waterfowl; this quest takes him into three different countries, 8 states, and includes over 110 days in the field, all in one season.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Cole Dutton
waypointtv.us.description: Texas is a land rich and plentiful, and one of the country's most sought-out destinations to hunt wild game; its hunting culture is driven by family and values, and the trophy itself is embedded within the experience.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Deer Day
waypointtv.us.description: Follow TTHA President/CEO Christina Pittman and her husband Matt as they tag alongside Dr. James Kroll for his annual deer day.

waypointtv.us.title: Wildbound by Forloh
waypointtv.us.description: Wildbound -- UK Part 2 Andy visits the land of Scotland; he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Opening Day in Mississippi
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 A look at turkey hunting in southwest Mississippi with Cragg Fitz during the opening week of turkey season.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Montrose Elk Pt. 2
waypointtv.us.description: Slade and the crew are finally able to catch up with these elk despite some pretty terrible weather conditions. It comes right down to the wire! Don't miss it.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Two More Turkeys Down in Mississippi!!!
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Missouri Project 2024 Part 2

waypointtv.us.title: Ship Shape TV

waypointtv.us.description: Painting Aluminum Hulls Tips for making improvements and repairs on boats and boat equipment.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Flips And Flops
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E10 Slade breaks down what's involved in taking a raw land tract and creating extremely desirable turn-key hunting properties; Caleb and Slade double up on some gobblers for Caleb's first turkey kill ever.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Missouri Project Part 3
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E14 Not only does Slade tag out in Missouri and Iowa, but a good family friend Kyle Hicks and "Turkey Man" Eddie Salter join in on a few hunts; Slade does work on finding new 1031 tax properties as well as a little controlled burn.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Summer Time Activities
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E15 Slade is staying busy around the house and testing summer plots with Deergro and Backwoods bachelor pad blend; he takes a quick look at the new 60 acres he and Ryan bought as an investment property; a throwback hunt from under the barn.

waypointtv.us.title: Hunting Land Man : Midwest Turkey Tour 2024
waypointtv.us.description: Host and real estate agent, Slade Priest, educates on everything from purchasing and flipping hunting properties, to improving existing ones.

waypointtv.us.description: S01 E16 The crew is in Kansas again chasing monster whitetails; this season makes 15 years that they have been going to Kansas and this year was special; this amazing listing in South Louisiana that's a little different for the "Hunting Land Man."

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Tim Smith
waypointtv.us.description: Vietnam War veteran Tim Smith recounts his time in Vietnam and surviving a direct hit by a missile.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Mike Macko
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E01 Charter boat captain Mike Macko recounts his grueling life in the engine room aboard a U.S. Navy ship in the South Pacific.

waypointtv.us.title: Operation Healing Heroes : Victoria Phillips
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 U.S. Army veteran Victoria Phillips shares her history of unimaginable trauma.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Valued Partners
waypointtv.us.description: Each year, the crew gets to spend time in camp with some friends; Zach from Big & J gets some time in a blind while reflecting on what hunting in Texas means to him; Texas provides a wide variety of game.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : The Hill
waypointtv.us.description: S01 E02 From its inception, the F E Hill Ranch creates opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories, including a tradition of fathers and sons hunting together.

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Double T Outfitters

waypointtv.us.title: Storytellers : Father-Son Tradition
waypointtv.us.description: S02 E04 The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters becomes a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin; in 2021, Gavin is able to take his largest buck to date with his dad, Heath, behind the camera.

waypointtv.us.description: Tournament angler Blair Wiggins of "Addictive Fishing" continues his fishing adventures but also shares his love of everything outdoors, including hunting, cooking, beekeeping and more.

waypointtv.us.description: S03 E02 Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves; they experience one of America's most storied duck hunts.

The couple was located and apprehended as they prepared to kill again.

400000091.title: The FBI Files
400000091.description: A young mother and her infant son mysteriously disappeared from their home. The woman's husband was the only suspect, but he was eventually cleared. There was no solid evidence that a crime had even been committed. Six months later, a local farmer found the remains of the missing woman and her child. Both had been murdered. Agents and local police had only one tiny piece of evidence, an unidentified hair found in the murdered woman's car. The hair was too small for analysis.
